games.name: 100 StarPaws Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️‍Can you find them all? ️

games.name: 8AM: The Shopping Mall
games.summary: "8AM: The Shopping Mall" is a suspense game set in an empty mall after closing. Watch through security cameras as strange movements unfold and decide if it’s a glitch, exhaustion, or something sinister until 8:00 a.m.

games.name: A Diamond Display
games.summary: The ultimate honest cash grab. No gameplay, no buggy levels, just a pristine spinning diamond and a leaderboard to flex your wealth. Why play broken games filled with microtransactions when you can cut out the middleman and just win at spending money? Pure status. Zero utility.

games.name: A Ridiculous Waste of Time
games.summary: A Ridiculous Waste of Time is a collection of casual mini-games designed to test your mind and your reflexes. There's something for everyone in this Ridiculous library of fun!

games.name: Angle
games.summary: ANGLE is a psychological horror experience that challenges the boundaries of perception. Developed by C.O.T.E Technology & Development Studios, the game plunges players into a fractured reality where every corner hides a distorted truth. With its atmospheric storytelling and high-tension gameplay, ANGLE focuses on environmental storytelling and the thin line between sanity and fear. Survive the unseen, question your surroundings, and discover what lies at the wrong angle.

games.name: Animal Bakery
games.summary: Manage a cozy subway bakery in an underground animal city - run by a "retired" gangster you're secretly investigating. Serve cute locals, expand the bakery, prepare for festivals, meet strange visitors and explore the subway after hours for fun stories and special rewards!

games.name: Asteroid Patrol
games.summary: Bang bang! Shoot raining asteroids, dodge attacks of flying insects and battle against huge weird monsters! Gain exp, level up, pick perk and then rinse & repeat. Story? Nobody cares. If you are looking for a difficult and punishing game, don't leave without playing this one.

games.name: Battle Magi
games.summary: Summoned from across time and space, the greatest mages battle for respect and dominance. Use a voice-driven magic system, combine spells and power-ups, and fight in chaotic PvP arenas designed for FFA and team combat.

games.name: Belfry
games.summary: It is said that when the bell of molten gold rings across the sky, the world beyond will take the place of this shore.The clock’s marks sum up life’s course. Moving its hands changes fate.The girl prays to the gods:“May happy days never fade. May the destined bloom never wither.”

games.name: Bio Fault
games.summary: Become a scientist forced to correct a biological error born within the walls of a secret laboratory. Use the environment to survive and destroy your creation.

games.name: Blitzpoint
games.summary: A minimalist modern military strategy tower defense game where you build and defend a forward operating base. Strategically place defenses, manage resources, and repel relentless waves of enemies. Build by day, defend by night, and command your forces in fast-paced, action-packed gameplay.

games.name: Boxed Beasts
games.summary:
Red Bob is an inventor and biologist determined to study the region’s entire fauna. To achieve his ambitions, he created a special capture box capable of containing creatures without harming them. His mission is to regulate the population of each biome to prevent ecological imbalance, while also capturing creatures for research.

However, an accident during the transportation of the boxes caused them to scatter across the region. Now, Red Bob must track them down in order to restore control and properly capture the creatures once again.

games.name: BrawlMart
games.summary: BrawlMart is a fast-paced, physics-driven party game where up to four players crash their carts through a rotating playlist of wild minigames. Every round twists the rules, every arena is unpredictable, and every match is absolute chaos.

games.name: Call of Girls
games.summary: Call of Girls is a fantasy RPG centered around "character collection + idle gameplay + strategic combat," emphasizing high-quality art and a relaxed, long-term play experience. The game features a unique storyline for each character, enhancing the collection and immersive experience.

games.name: Calm Horizon
games.summary: "Sea of Serenity" - Sail with friends through ever-changing seas! Fish rare species, tame magical pets, and uncover island mysteries. Build your legendary crew under dynamic day-night cycles. Adventure awaits!

games.name: Castle of no Escape
games.summary: Explore the mysterious castle full of monsters and secrets in a quest to collect all the treasures (that will also protect you from the curses on your way) and crush the main boss. The game won't let you exit the castle, no matter how you try. Technically you can win, but there is no end.

games.name: Cats in Wonderland
games.summary: The Queen of Hearts had a fit of rage after the Cheshire Cat refused to be her pet and ordered the capture of all the cats in Wonderland. Find them before her and prevent anything bad from happening.

games.name: Chick That Never Skipped a Leg Day
games.summary: Can you reach the top? Chick That Never Skipped a Leg Day is a brutal-cute 3D precision climb. A tiny chick. Massive legs. The Golden Leg Press awaits. Solo or online with friends.

games.name: Chuxie2
games.summary: This time the player will play the role of a trainee exorcist,and her first task is to find missing persons.It seems like a simple task,but she has no idea what a terrifying and unimaginable existence she is about to face.

games.name: CityZen
games.summary: CityZen is a game about building small cities without stressful mechanics like confusing traffic systems, unexpected disasters or constraining resource management.

games.name: Cloud Shadow
games.summary: In Yunnan, China, there is a rich variety of mushrooms, and the local people have a culture of consuming mushrooms and "picking mushrooms". When a young boy mistakenly eats a hallucinogenic wild mushroom, he embarks on a series of fantastical adventures.

games.name: Content Warning
games.summary: Film your friends doing scary things to become SpöökTube famous!

games.name: Core Hustlers
games.summary: Core Hustlers is a single-player sci-fi extraction shooter where every run is unique. Infiltrate derelict stations, hack data cores, outthink ruthless AI, and survive shifting, deadly environments.

games.name: Counter Attack on Zombies
games.summary: Fight through zombie-filled battle zones, survive relentless waves, and upgrade your combat power in this fast-paced action survival shooter.

games.name: Crazy Odyssey
games.summary: "Crazy Odyssey" is a hilarious, relaxing idle ARPG where epic loot meets pure chaos! Experience addictive grinding and looting gameplay, wacky storylines, and absurd skills. Laugh your way through a bizarre fantasy adventure where even your weapons might troll you

games.name: Crimson Realms: Relics of the Forgotten World
games.summary: Embark on a colorful adventure in Crimson Realms! Battle creatures with four unique attack styles, defeat powerful demons to claim relics, overcome perilous obstacles, and complete epic missions in a world filled with danger and wonder.

games.name: Curse Words
games.summary: Curse Words is a roguelike FPS about swearing! Use your real voice to unleash powerful abilities based on your favorite swear words. Slay hordes of enemies, level up, and unlock new words and upgrades to create insane builds!

games.name: DFClicker
games.summary: April's Fools game, incremental clicker where you click the big DF

games.name: Date Senbei
games.summary: this is a dark comedy full of terrible people. the content is meant for mature audiences, viewer discretion is advised.

games.name: Dead End Streets
games.summary: Dead End Streets – Explore a forgotten street where each house hides a disturbing experiment. Discover VIVARQ's secrets, face what dwells within, and survive a system that never stopped watching you.

games.name: Drawn to Drift
games.summary: A competitive space racing game. Drift on player built tracks for the best times and claim your rank on the global leaderboards.

games.name: Dropcore
games.summary: Dropcore is a 2D online arena game where players use knockback, not damage, to eliminate opponents. Master gravity, dodge bullets, and blast rivals off the stage in chaotic maps. Choose your class, grab a weapon, and outplay your friends in fast-paced physics brawls.

games.name: Duel de Base Stat
games.summary:
Challenge other players to 1-on-1 battles based on Pokémon's base stats!
Using a set of 6 random Pokémon, build the best base stat team by selecting the Pokémon's stats

games.name: Dwarven Village: Dark Siege Td
games.summary: Dwarven Village Dark Siege is a game that you need to defend your crystals from orcs and goblins, Place Allies on paths, Place towers to the sides and make upgrades in the village

games.name: Everdawn
games.summary: Everdawn is a peaceful building strategy and puzzle game where you create a beautiful and ever-growing landscape by placing tiles. Explore a variety of biomes, discover and unlock new tiles and complete quests to fill your world with life!

games.name: Fairy Tale TD:Hero
games.summary: This is a 3D pigeon tower defense game that utilizes resources to build turrets and collaborates with heroes to block enemy attacks.

games.name: Feed the Feed
games.summary: Feed the Feed is a clone of Snake released by Tumblr which was made for April Fools 2026.

games.name: Fling Up Together
games.summary: Fling up together is a chaotic co-op physics platformer 2-4 Players where one fling yeets everyone! Solve color-based puzzles, climb together (or fall together), and laugh your way through a vibrant Arabian-inspired world.

games.name: Fredbear Game Number 998433
games.summary: Can you survive Fredbear's? Test your skills and knowledge in this next-generation reimagining. Watch those cameras and close your doors, or else you'll get caught! I know somebody who didn't. You do too. You knew him too well.

games.name: Funny UFOs Scene Creator
games.summary:
Make "funny" scenes starring the cast of the Funny UFOs series! Featuring iconic characters like Biggo Blast, Baby Birdungo, The Squink, and more across 8 different worlds to explore. Right click characters to turn them around. Right click on objects to make extra copies.

I've always loved the scene creator genre, and it was awesome getting to create my own. Maybe more to come?

games.name: GTJ: Grand Theft Japan
games.summary: Grand Theft Japan is a tribute to GTA and Yakuza, set in Japan. Featuring stories inspired by real events: soaring rice prices, roaming bears, yakuza clans, otaku culture, and shocking political incidents.

games.name: Gladiator Ascension
games.summary: Gladiator Ascension is an overpowered incremental gladiatorial experience! Prove yourself in combat and win your freedom!

games.name: Glass Cannon Defense
games.summary: A short incremental game where you defeat incoming enemies and make a glass cannon increasingly powerful.

games.name: Goat Simulator 3
games.summary: Pilgor’s baaack! Gather your herd and venture forth into Goat Simulator 3; a totally realistic, sandbox farmyard experience. Invite up to three friends in local or online co-op, create carnage together, or compete in mini-games and then not be friends.

games.name: Gripless: Drift Valley
games.summary: Indie drifting game with smooth arcade drift physics, multiple game modes and winding natural roads. Choose your tires wisely, adapt to changing weather and master every slide!

games.name: Haste
games.summary: Haste is a fast-paced running game where you race to reach the portal at the end of a collapsing universe. Run through an infinite amount of levels where no world is ever the same. Between each attempt to complete your run you have the chance to explore a hub world, gather your strength, meet characters and practice your skills before heading out for another adventure. Each run has its own unique challenges with clues to figure out why the worlds are breaking apart.

games.name: Hentai Obsession
games.summary: Embark on a relaxing and sensual puzzle journey with Hentai Obsession, where each calming level and every completed image gently soothes your mind.

games.name: Her Red Cosmos
games.summary: A burnt out singer seeks solitude in her deceased grandmother's old home. Then something starts leaving her flowers.

games.name: I Know a Guy
games.summary: Run your pizza shop up front and handle shady business out back. Help hand-crafted NPCs with favors that never go as planned. Play solo or online co-op with up to four players and expand your operation across Hobarey Town. In this darkly comedic management sim - become that guy everyone knows.

games.name: Incretyper
games.summary: Incretyper is an incremental typing game where every word you type can trigger powerful effects. Destroy shapes, unlock upgrades and watch your typing power grow into chaotic chain reactions.

games.name: Jajo
games.summary: Jajo is an arcade game inspired by Game and Watch set and by Volk-san: Egg&Catch, by Lampy. The latter unfortunately was removed from Itch.io. I really enjoyed Volk-san: Egg&Catch so with a little help from Mia, I was able to build this game.

games.name: Jonathan's Adventure! Pricker Edition
games.summary: A gang of misfits are brought by an ambitious director to work on a film based on their adventures, however, not everything is what it's promised to be.

games.name: Juufuutei Raden's Guide for Pixel Museum
games.summary: A VTuber from hololive DEV_IS, "Juufuutei Raden" from ReGLOSS, will guide you through a museum as the curator. The entire game world, including Curator Raden and the museum, is depicted in "pixel art". The illustrations are completed by solving logic nonogram puzzles.

games.name: Kiosk 199X
games.summary: Run a tiny 90s kiosk in a chaotic Eastern country - Kolkhozland. Serve quirky customers, survive inspections, pick a side in a local power struggle, and uncover a hidden conspiracy - all in a story-driven retro management sim full of humor and choices.

games.name: Last Meadow Online
games.summary: April Fools' game playable within the Discord client. Pick your class, team up with Discordians around the world, and take down an ancient dragon threatening all things living and green.

games.name: Letter Trek
games.summary: Hop on board the Letter Trek bus for fun and frolicking word games for 1-4 players. Whether flying solo or playing with your pals, Letter Trek is an accessible, playful, brain-teasing trip for the whole family. Head to the beach to play Sandy Stacks! Your task is to build a tower of words that climbs into the sky - the higher you go, the higher your score! Dig up letters, golden shells and wildcards from the sand, and challenge your companions - or yourself - to form the highest scoring words in a crossword-style grid. Stop by the canyon for Lightning Letters! Connect jumbled letters to create as many words as you can before the timer runs out. Watch for the new lightning letter appearing midway through the match. Use it quickly before it changes! Grab your phones and take a ride with the Letter Trek gang today!

games.name: Liekki
games.summary: Liekki is a fast-paced puzzle platformer where you play as a little fire spirit and try to burn as much as possible – or as little as possible. Solve levels using different fire related powers and change levels while burning them down.

games.name: Life in Jasskia: a Coffee Shop
games.summary: A political-economic shop survival game. In a world nearing its end, the national and global agenda in crisis-stricken Jasskia shifts every day. In the middle of it all, build your business, meet people, witness unsettling truths, find ways to make money, and prepare for the coming end.

games.name: Liminal Underground: Creatures Beyond
games.summary: Overview: Make way through levels full of danger. Creatures lurk and hunt you down throughout the levels. Design: A horror, adventure with Objectives, creatures chasing you, and secret exits to find. Finding each exit, gets you closer to escaping. Localization: Recommended language: English

games.name: Lofi Mahjong
games.summary: Dive into a calm, cozy world with Lofi Mahjong. Enjoy classic Mahjong Solitaire enhanced by a lofi soundscape for maximum focus and minimum stress.

games.name: Mercury Elopement Syndrome
games.summary: A short visual novel. A 24-hour romance at its worst; a 24-hour escape at its sweetest.

games.name: Midnight Shifts with Femboy
games.summary: In this sandbox visual novel, you must survive your shifts at a convenience store while being watched by an obsessive admirer. Interact with your environment and build a delicate bond with a cute yandere femboy. Your choices will determine if you can help him heal or if his love will consume you...

games.name: MoneyClicker
games.summary: A minimalist incremental clicker about earning money, upgrading income, and prestiging for endless growth.

games.name: Monitor State
games.summary: You are an operator in a dystopia world, watch and punish citizens. Experience a deep narrative with moral dilemmas. Obey, resist or find another path.

games.name: Monster Ops 17
games.summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

games.name: Morkull: Ascend to the Gods
games.summary: Play as Morkull, God of Death and Darkness. Aware that he finds himself in a video game once again, you must help him escape so he can carry out his new plan for world domination. To do so, you must defeat an entire pantheon of gods in thrilling boss battles.

games.name: Mullet Cop the Game
games.summary: Mullet Cop the Game is an isometric mall simulation with a mashup of idle & action, set inside the chaotic Megamall 4472-158. Players build and manage their own mall while maintaining order as threats emerge. Balance growth, security, and escalating chaos through the game’s dynamic “violence” system, where peace is never guaranteed. Encounter a cast of eccentric heroes and villains as you shape the future of a mall that’s barely under control.

games.name: My Type of Goblin: A Climbing ASDFenture
games.summary: Use the whole keyboard to climb, slingshot, and slide your way up a mountain. Collect bizarre accessories on your quest to become the most gorgeous Goblin. But one mistake can send you tumbling back down.

games.name: Night Shift Customer
games.summary: A night shift at a minimarket turns into a nightmare. Serve customers, tidy the store, and watch for oddities - one of them isn’t human anymore.

games.name: NubiaPhobia
games.summary: Solve the wacky point & click puzzles filled with horror and humor. Break the witch's curse on your home as you explore five distinct regions, each hiding a sacred key to unlock the village chest.

games.name: Optico
games.summary: Optico is a 2D point and click puzzle adventure game with hand drawn art in noir aesthetics. You need to solve the puzzles to discover the secret, a treasure far beyond your expectations.

games.name: Orin Gamble
games.summary:
A short, luck-based visual novel about a mysterious girl and the rumors surrounding her.

Getting the ending you want comes down to a dice roll.

games.name: Paic: Moon Rider Story
games.summary: Ride a motorcycle along a seaside coast at sunset, rendered in pixel art. A short visual novel game. Read through the story, survive the death game, and make it home safely!

games.name: Pegture
games.summary: Pegture is a peg solitaire-themed roguelike, deck-building game. Build your deck, enhance your pegs, perform frenetic combos, beat bosses, reach the highest score and get the best peg solitaire experience.

games.name: Penniless Chef
games.summary: "Penniless Chef" is a game where you run and grow your own restaurant. Run and grow your restaurant, and get to know the villagers!

games.name: Phase Knight
games.summary: In this cyber-knight action RPG, you are Renn Kale—part human, part machine, blessed with divine blood. Master three combat forms, slash through the war-torn galaxy, and decide the fate of flesh, steel, and data. The revolution begins with your blade

games.name: Pikuniku
games.summary: Pikuniku is a puzzle and adventure game set in a colorful world. The player controls Piku, a small red creature, guiding him through levels and solving puzzles that mostly involve kicking and pushing objects onto switches to open the way forward. Piku can lasso his legs to swing from hooks and zip lines, curl into a ball to roll, ride minecarts, and travel through pipes to reach new areas. Along the way the player meets villagers to talk with and can spend coins earned in levels on items such as hats. A local co-op mode lets a second player control a similar orange creature named Niku across a set of cooperative levels.

games.name: PinBall Escape
games.summary: Navigate a celestial library in this roguelike vertical pinball adventure. Master agile flippers to overcome magical obstacles and reach new heights. Precision is everything in this high-stakes climb where one fall can reset your progress. Escape God's study!

games.name: Poubelle City
games.summary: Poubelle City: Dive into a vibrant and offbeat metropolis where the raw energy of the streets meets authenticity! Explore iconic locations and feel the rhythm of the legendary night with DJ Aye-Aye!

games.name: Racar
games.summary: RACAR, developed by TECNO BROS, has evolved to become a next generation online shooter. This game now offers high-quality graphics and an immersive experience that rivals the most famous titles. In RACAR, players can join intense online battles, facing off against opponents from around the world in exciting, action-packed futuristic scenarios.

games.name: Rebungered!! That Time I Got Reincarnated As A Bunger!
games.summary:
Have you ever wondered what it would be like to live as a Bunger from the hit game Bugsnax? Well now you can!!

Introducing...
Rebungered!! That Time I Got Reincarnated As A Bunger!

A real and actual text adventure from the Young Horses. It is not spoiler free, so if you have not completed the main game, be advised!

games.name: Revenge On Gold Diggers
games.summary: The first-ever FMV game about emotional fraud, brought to life by Chinese director Hu Yaohui and a team of film industry veterans. In this entirely fictional story, step into the role of a hunter of hearts and infiltrate a shadowy organization deep in emotional deceit. In this immersive, third-person cinematic experience, every choice matters as you navigate a treacherous web of lies, seduction, and manipulation. The game features 472 minutes of cinematic footage, over 200 choices, and 38 possible endings. You can also explore the Love Dossier with over 140,000 words, and interact with others on the Wall of Memories, which already contains more than 4,000 player comments.

games.name: Rocket Penguin
games.summary: Rocket Penguin is a unique 2D flying game that may seem simple but requires master-level skills to reach outer space.

games.name: Rulers of Cospaia
games.summary: Rulers of Cospaia is a digital board game of medieval strategy where you build your realm on a hexagonal board, gather resources, expand your city, and choose your path to victory — through economy, strength, or sabotage.

games.name: Rune Rhythm Realm
games.summary: Defend global seals in this dark fantasy rhythm-typing TD with roguelite elements, eliminating enemies via real-time letter typing while strategically deploying traps (spacebar) and activating skills (number keys) to the beat.

games.name: Sad Virus Castle
games.summary: Sad Virus is back in new walking simulation version. Now mission to find beer bottles in castle themed area

games.name: Scales
games.summary: Scales is a story-driven action-adventure RPG about a human-reptile hybrid. Players devour reptiles to absorb their DNA, and evolve through a corrupt world, where player choices ultimately determine the outcome of the story, blending combat with a darkly comedic narrative.

games.name: Sevens
games.summary: Sevens is a competitive multiplayer card experience set in a dark underground club atmosphere. Sit at the table, read your opponents, disrupt their strategy, and fight to control the flow of the game — whether you're playing with friends, strangers, or bots.

games.name: Shadows Show
games.summary: Are you ready to face the mysteries of the past? The player will explore the gloomy environment of the hospital, encountering creepy phenomena and supernatural creatures. Uncover the story of the disappearance of all the inhabitants of the "Red Forest" sanatorium.

games.name: Shop Town Dooter
games.summary: A chaotic party top-down shooter. In arenas that throw different surprises every round, find a way to out-perform your friends, even if it means cheating, bribing, or bringing a MECH to a gunfight! Upgrade your guns mid-fights for maximum results. - no refunds in case of friendship destruction.

games.name: Shu
games.summary: SHU is a strategic tower defense game where you place and upgrade archers, mages, and artillery towers to stop waves of goblins and warriors from reaching your base. Earn gold, manage your defenses, and build your own custom maps with the built-in map editor.

games.name: Sim: Heavyweight Boxing Champion
games.summary: Manage a heavyweight boxer from turning pro to undisputed champion. 500+ fighters, 4 world titles, 7 regional belts, live round-by-round commentary, rivalries, awards, and a deep career mode spanning 1,000+ years. Chase greatness. Unify them all.

games.name: Slorbis: Tower Defense
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the cozy, minimalist world of Slorbis: Tower Defense. Build towers with unique roles, buy modifiers of varying rarities, collect money, and face the unpredictability of procedurally generated maps as you defend the king from dark spirits.

games.name: Space Commanders
games.summary: A lone space commander explores real planetary surfaces, builds small outposts, rescues stranded astronauts, and fights to survive in the cold silence of the Solar System.

games.name: Space Control
games.summary: You've been abducted by an intergalactic megacorporation, Glorpo Inc! Work off your debt with your alien crew - abduct new recruits, take care of alien babies and cook up some questionable space snacks!

games.name: Spark Ignites
games.summary: A pixel fantasy RPG where the Star God's Blessing grants one wish each century. Orphan Ash and Clover uncover its bloody truth during their pilgrimage. Holding a world-changing secret, will you steal divine power or defy the gods? Every choice writes a new ending.

games.name: Storytime Cats: A Twilight Tale
games.summary: Storytime Cats – A Twilight Tale is a hidden object game set in a magical storybook world. Search for playful cats across 7 hand-drawn levels, each brimming with charm and cozy twilight magic!

games.name: Swifty
games.summary: A fast-paced 2D platformer where speed, precision, and perfect timing are key. Dodge traps, master challenging levels, and become the ultimate "Swifty".

games.name: Symbolika
games.summary: You are neither a hero nor a mere candidate: you are a variable. Symbolikus chose you because your destiny is blurred. He wants to see if you will be able to transcend classic archetypes (Warrior, Mage, Cyber...) by mastering the magic of Symbols. Your goal? Traverse the 29 Strata of the Arena, Use powerful combinations based on the values and symbols of your cards to deal devastating damage to your enemies, reach the Creator, and prove your worth by leaving an indelible mark on him.

games.name: Teckel Adventure
games.summary: Play as Luna, a brave dachshund, and embark on a 2D platforming adventure full of secrets, enemies, and challenges to recover your favorite ball. Explore, overcome challenges, improve your scores, and discover multiple game modes to extend the adventure.

games.name: Test Release Do Not Buy!!!
games.summary: Do not Wishlist this game. There is nothing here.

games.name: The People of Sea, Sun & Salt
games.summary: Will you create a lasting civilization or see it collapse into the sea? In Sea, Sun & Salt, you build a city on a small mediterranean island. Define the tenets of your culture, deal with your subjects' needs and withstand the forces of the elements.

games.name: The Spirit Weaver
games.summary: The Spirit Weaver is a narrative-driven visual novel where you use the power of Tarot to guide lost spirits through their grief, and maybe figure out your own. Explore a mystical spirit realm, help its denizens, and restore balance in a bittersweet story of love, loss, and empathy.

games.name: Thumbylina
games.summary: Thumbylina is a fingertip-sized life simulation game device designed to be your daily companion. When you set a timer during study or exercise, your in-game character joins you in self-improvement—unlocking new outfits and hairstyles as you progress. Unlike smartphone or PC timer apps, Thumbylina is completely offline, allowing you to focus without any distracting notifications.

games.name: Tiny: The Last Wayfinder
games.summary: A wholesome adventure through an oversized world. Explore freely, solve puzzles, and unlock new paths using magic, tools, and traversal abilities in this calm, atmospheric world filled with secrets, story, and gentle creatures.

games.name: UndertaleForFree
games.summary: UndertaleForFree is an April Fools game which was initially disguised as a web port of Undertale. Upon launch of the website, the game started off like the regular game up until the title card, in which it would break revealing the joke game underneath. The actual game itself is a clone of CrazyBus, which includes enemy encounters from Undertale for the bus to run over.

games.name: Unit 42: Adrift in Space
games.summary: An incremental journey through space. Manage your ship's capsules, choose your path through the stars, and watch your crew and automation do the rest.

games.name: Unsettled: Night Shift
games.summary: Unsettled: NIGHT SHIFT is a horror game about the terrors of daily life experienced by someone who has moved to a new city to live alone.

games.name: Waddle Words
games.summary: Waddle, spell, and honk your way to victory in this chaotic word game for 1–4 players!

games.name: Way to Hell 2 New Era
games.summary: FPS shooter sequel where mission is to kill big bloody monster and then destroy doors and find pentagrams in different levels

games.name: Whatnever
games.summary: An interactive comic about depression, creativity, a Deer mask and eyes-guys.

games.name: 10s
games.summary: 10s is a frantic arcade puzzle game of speed and precision! Follow the radar, match target blocks, and build massive combos to earn extra time. Climb the global Steam leaderboards, beat real players' high scores in the asynchronous Rival system, and prove you are the fastest. Every second counts!

games.name: A Tiny Life
games.summary: Anna must rely on little fairy creatures called Pluckies to help her get the parts of her super shrinking machine back before 30 days or else she will stay this small size forever.

games.name: ACA Neo Geo: Master of Syougi
games.summary:
"Master of Syougi" is a shogi game released by SNK in 1995.
It stands as the only authentic shogi (Japanese chess) title for the Neo Geo system, offering both standard shogi and the simplified "hasami shogi."
With adjustable settings to display beginner guides or play with handicaps (piece drops), the game is designed to be enjoyed by everyone from novices to true masters!

games.name: Animal Genius
games.summary: Animal Genius turns animal trivia into a colorful classroom adventure where every question feels like a mini safari. Test your knowledge across three fun categories—identity, habitats, and wild fun facts—to discover just how much you really know about creatures big and small. With simple controls, bright visuals, and a friendly quiz-master vibe, it’s perfect for kids, families, and anyone who wants to see just how wild their animal brain really is.

games.name: Apart
games.summary: Run your own toy workshop in this horror-themed crafting simulation game. Chop, saw, paint, pack, and deliver toys for your mysterious customers.

games.name: Beat the Beats
games.summary: Beat the Beats is an electric mix of rhythm and boxing! Use real in-ring style-punches to pound your way through musical arcade levels in hypnotic VR. Get pumped, get moving and beat the beats!

games.name: Bell Knight
games.summary: Traverse a cave overrun by monsters, strike down malevolent spirits, and uphold the sacred duty of the Bell Society. Praise the Bell.

games.name: Blockbound
games.summary: One swap away from the exit

games.name: Button Prison
games.summary: You find yourself trapped in a mysterious room upon awakening. Surrounding you are sparse pieces of furniture, mannequins, and countless buttons. Can you safely escape this room?

games.name: Castle Arena
games.summary: Castle Arena is a classic real-time strategy (RTS) game where you defend your own castle while aiming to conquer the enemy's. Master the rock-paper-scissors dynamics between Warriors, Mages, and Knights, and command your troops with intuitive tap-and-drag controls.

games.name: Cat Block: Sliding Puzzle
games.summary: Meet adorable cats in Cat Block - Sliding Puzzle. Move cat blocks and guide the yarn ball to its goal through 300 stages, with switchable cat skins, themed wallpapers, and relaxing music.

games.name: Cats in Paint
games.summary: A group of little kittens has quietly hidden in the painting, waiting for you to discover them!

games.name: Clean Up Earth
games.summary:
Clean Up Earth is a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Clean Up Earth is the first original IP from Magic Pockets studio, based in France. Clean Up Earth will be available on PC (Steam, Epic Games Store) in Q1 2026, with the console launch dates to be confirmed following the Kickstarter campaign.

Clean Up Earth invites players to restore polluted environments to their natural beauty and unwind, solo or with friends. Using the Terra Cleaner, a futuristic, customisable cleaning tool, they rejuvenate landscapes inspired by the real world, from serene mountain ranges to tropical beaches. As they progress, they unlock new modules and upgrades to take on increasingly complex challenges. The Terra Cleaner can also be used to repair damaged equipment and structures, enabling players to use them to access new zones.

The game supports solo play and cooperative multiplayer, with maps for 2 to 8 players depending on their size, as well as larger maps that accommodate 30+ players.

games.name: Conejito Cagón
games.summary: Luna is a domestic rabbit with an unpredictable digestive temperament. Her constant trail of chaos forces Fermín, a small cleaning robot, to follow her through houses, patios, streets and forests in an attempt to restore order. As Luna’s mess escalates, new creatures and obstacles appear, turning a simple cleaning task into a strange journey across increasingly surreal environments.

games.name: Cursed Blood
games.summary: Play as vengeful Samurai Apes fueled by blood in a lightning-fast mix of stealth and action. Spill blood, cut limbs and claim vengeance.

games.name: Cursed Words
games.summary: From letters to lunacy, Cursed Words is a roguelike chasing ever-stronger synergies. Start with simple words like BUY or THIS or GAME, then use game-altering combos to break the rules. Before long you’ll be ¼♖♙K5XNG the ⅗H♗4 out of these 83VK??7?!

games.name: Dangerous Superheroes After Dark: Heroes Behind the Mask
games.summary: When the city sleeps, their control begins to slip. Behind every mask… there’s a man who could ruin you. Will you earn his trust or surrender to the danger?

games.name: Dangerous Superheroes After Dark: Heroines Behind the Mask
games.summary:
When the city sleeps, their secrets awaken.
Behind every mask… there’s a woman who could break you.
Will you uncover the truth or fall for the danger?

games.name: Darwin's Paradox!
games.summary: Dive into the adventure with Darwin, an octopus as endearing as he is ingenious, torn from the ocean and trapped in a vast and mysterious industrial complex. Harness his unique talents and abilities to help him overcome the many dangers and traps in this captivating platformer and adventure game.

games.name: Dealer's Doom
games.summary: A single-player blackjack roguelike where every bet is a build choice and every floor rewrites the rules. Hit, stand, double, split, and insure your way through escalating bosses, brutal modifiers, and wildly synergetic runs.

games.name: Demon Work Walk: Hello Work Poke Park
Derelict Star
games.summary: A precise momentum-based platformer that emphasizes exploration and navigation puzzles. Run and jump your way through a wide variety of obstacles and challenges as you explore an abandoned derelict freighter.

games.name: Duck Battle Royale
games.summary: Step into the wacky world of Duck Battle Royale, where feathers fly and victory is quackers! Take on a hilarious cast of rivals as you fight your way to the top, one ridiculous showdown at a time. Every encounter is full of surprises, silly twists, and over-the-top moments that will keep you laughing.

games.name: Duck Dash Delivery
games.summary: Duck Dash Delivery is a casual life management simulator where you play as a duck working to lift your family out of poverty. Navigate city traffic, avoid collisions, upgrade your scooter, and choose the most profitable delivery orders to save your family from their financial struggles.

games.name: Easter Bunny EggVenture
games.summary: Get ready to hop into a world of festive fun with Easter Bunny EggVenture, the egg‑citing spot the difference challenge bursting with springtime charm! Each level presents two cheerful Easter scenes filled with bunnies, baskets, and brightly patterned eggs that seem identical at first glance… but look again. Hidden among the pastel colors and playful details are clever differences waiting to be discovered.

games.name: Eggconsole C-So! MSX
games.summary: Master the C-SO and take down the Wargaki gang across 10 action-packed stages! Just watch out for the pesky Balloons that can pass right through walls!

games.name: Ember Island
games.summary: Relive the arcade glory days in Ember Island, a relentless quarter burner where every mistake costs blood and time. Fight through 12 deadly zones as a Knight, Mage, or Rogue. Chase high scores for lives, hit the checkpoints, and use unlimited continues to earn your mastery. Play the demo now.

games.name: Ember's Verge
games.summary: Bushcraft and survive on a deserted island where nature is both your greatest ally and fiercest adversary. As the weather turns colder toward winter, preparation becomes key to survival. Build shelters, hunt, fish, farm, and craft items from natural resources—all without any modern tools.

games.name: Enjoy Amoy & Sisters
games.summary: "Enjoy Amoy & Sisters"‌ is a live-action interactive romance game. You play as an overseas Chinese person who, in response to the invitation from the two female leads, Ah Yin and Xiao Xi, visits Xiamen, the ancestral hometown, for the first time.

games.name: Espectro the Fighters Focus
games.summary: Espectro - The Fighter's Focus is a beat 'em up action game with retro visuals and exuberant pixel art. Espectro and his allies, Sayuri and Iron Crusher, face hordes of enemies and powerful bosses in their quest for justice.

games.name: European Truck Simulator
games.summary:
Drive powerful trucks across Europe.
Deliver cargo and complete transport jobs.
Upgrade your trucks and expand your fleet.

games.name: Extreme Garage: Offroad
games.summary: Challenge of speed and skill.

games.name: Farmer's Dynasty 2
games.summary: An idyllic farm surrounded by picturesque landscapes. Embrace the seasons to build, farm and feel the country life in the open game world of Farmer's Dynasty 2. Inherit the family farm as the next generation to prosper and create a farming legacy.

games.name: Game With Balls
games.summary: Game With Balls! Move the Steam Deck to navigate through handcrafted mazes.

games.name: Genkai: Primal Awakening
games.summary: Combine tactics and strategy in this roguelike deckbuilder, where you must build your deck, train and evolve your team. Step into a mystical world where the Genkai battle in a quest for power and harmony, and prepare for the imminent arrival of the Primal Genkai.

games.name: Go! Go! Mister Chickums
games.summary: GO! GO! MISTER CHICKUMS is a fun, classic single-screen platformer, inspired by arcade hits of the 80s. The game can be played either in single player mode, or in local couch co-op with 2 players simultaneously.

games.name: Grab 50 Coins
games.summary:
Your goal is to Grab 50 Coins and reach the exit before the spikes crush you! The door will not reveal itself until you Grab 50 Coins!
Time your movements correctly as you'll face spikes, platforms, and holes in the level!
Don't worry if you miss a few - there's always more than 50 in each level!

games.name: Hearthstorm
games.summary: General, prepare your army for victorious battles. Select the card and make your first move!

games.name: Hentai Furry Panda
games.summary: Hentai Furry Panda is an adult anime puzzle game featuring a playful furry panda girl. Solve memory and puzzle challenges to unlock new illustrations, achievements, and gallery content.

games.name: Hentai Sin
games.summary: Embark on a relaxing and sensual puzzle journey with Hentai Sin, where each calming level and every completed image gently soothes your mind.

games.name: Hero Siege
games.summary: Hero Siege is a Hack 'n' Slash game with roguelike- & RPG elements. Annihilate hordes of enemies, grow your talent tree, grind better loot and explore up to 7 Acts enhanced with beautiful Pixel Art graphics! This game offers countless hours of gameplay and up to 4 player online multiplayer!

games.name: House of Empty Names
games.summary: You wake up on a cold floor in an unknown house, missing a kidney, and realize you've been kidnapped. Your one goal is to escape at any cost. Choose where to go, where to hide, and how to build your path to freedom. Every decision brings you one step closer to escape.

games.name: I Am Jesus Christ
games.summary: Walk in the footsteps of Jesus in this immersive first-person retelling of His life, from baptism to resurrection. Perform iconic miracles, meet biblical figures, and explore the Holy Land from Jerusalem to Galilee. Experience the story of the Messiah in I Am Jesus Christ.

games.name: I Hear Them
games.summary: You hear scurrying in the ceiling. You hear scratching in the walls. Your house is infested with rats, and its your job to get rid of them. Catch rats with the help of your best friend, Lola, and uncover the supernatural mysteries behind their gatherings inside your new home.

games.name: I Want to Run Away From My Goth Mommy... or Do I?
games.summary: You dashed into the first apartment you could find, trying to escape the sudden downpour—and here's the result: a slamming door, an unfamiliar interior, and… her.

games.name: Infinicrypt
games.summary: Take control of one of 3 mighty heroes to vanquish an evil as old as time. Dodge attacks, slay monsters, and collect items in this bullet-hell dungeon-delving roguelike! Are you ready for the infinite depths?

games.name: Irooni: Color Tag
games.summary: Touch the right color, or die. Trapped in an abandoned night school, you are hunted by a shifting nightmare. To hide, you must follow the rules of a twisted game: touch the correct colors around you to stay invisible. One mistake is fatal. Can you survive the night?

games.name: Jaleco Sports: Bases Loaded 2
games.summary: Bases Loaded is back for a second season with even more classic baseball action!

games.name: Japanese Basics Hiragana Fill-in Quiz
games.summary: Learn Hiragana fast—fill-in-the-blank quizzes for Japanese beginners.

games.name: Jax vs. the World
games.summary: Jax Vs. The World is a life sim turn based RPG about overcoming life's struggles. You play as Jax on a mission from a mysterious source. On this mission you come across obstacles and trials you might find in real life. In a world based on Birmingham AL. Can you accomplish mission impossible?

games.name: Jewel Match Solitaire X
games.summary: Explore a fantastical world in this new Solitaire adventure!

games.name: Killest Fights Craw-Mech
games.summary: Killest Fights Craw-Mech is a turn based sci-fi RPG about Killest taking his revenge on the RDA (Robot Destruction Agency). Rampage through a robot-filled base, push around a weak-willed supervisor, hopefully run into no barrel puzzles, and face your past head first in this epic onslaught...

games.name: Kraken Cleaning
games.summary: Kraken Cleaning is an incremental game where you clean the ocean as a giant kraken. Collect trash, recycle it into pearls, unlock abyssal powers, and free ocean creatures that help your cleanup operation.

games.name: Little Devil
games.summary:
Little Devil is a top-down roguelike horror-comedy dripping with 90s retro attitude, grotesque demons, and chaotic dungeon energy — developed by Michael Armstrong-Ingram of MI Pixel Ltd.

Descend into Hell armed with bizarre powers that shoot from your hands. Battle grotesque demons, navigate procedurally generated dungeons filled with ever-shifting room layouts, survive encounters with massive bosses, and die. Then do it all again. Permadeath means every run is a fresh fight for survival but the chaos never gets old.
Face off against the Seven Deadly Sins as bosses, each with their own grotesque attack patterns and behaviours. Loot, upgrade, discover secret rooms, and uncover trial challenges that reward the bold with hidden treasures.

The world of Little Devil runs deeper than the game alone. The Little Devil Webcomic, updating weekly on WEBTOON and free to read, tells the origin story of the characters and world you'll be battling through.

games.name: Living Dead House
games.summary: Living Dead House delivers a pulse pounding, classic arcade experience. Battle through waves of the undead solo or team up with a friend. Use an arsenal of weapons and survival items to outlast the night. Will you escape alive and claim your top spot on the leaderboard?

games.name: Logiart Grimoire
games.summary:
Logiart is a "Picture Logic Puzzle" that uses vertical and horizontal numbers as hints to complete illustrations.
It has simple and easy-to-understand rules, making it accessible for anyone to play.
Various assist functions are also included, allowing for a smooth gameplay experience.
You can also choose to turn off the assist functions if desired.

games.name: Magic Exposure 2
games.summary: Find new love or mend a broken relationship as you make key choices in a yuri-themed visual novel adventure!

games.name: Mahjong Inkflow
games.summary: This a 2D ink-wash solo game blending classic mahjong wins with light roguelikes. In game, you'll play as an ink drop, defeat foes by completing mahjong hands. Collect cards & orbs on the way, gain skills from special enemies, and experiment with builds in this vivid world!

games.name: Man's Last Friends
games.summary: Emilio is a dachshund on his way to his very first day at doggy daycare! There he'll meet new friends, eat new treats, and learn new things! Though... Maybe there are things he wishes he didn't learn about...

games.name: MaoMaoMao
games.summary: Turn your productivity into currency! MaoMaoMao is a cozy desktop companion where typing on your keyboard earns you coins. Adopt 20+ unique cats, discover their secret quirks, and decorate their Room and Garden. Watch them climb, sleep and occasionally break your furniture while you working.

games.name: Micro Mages Maker
games.summary: Micro Mages Maker is a level editor of Micro Mages, a platform game developed for the 8-bit console. Create your own levels, share them with everyone! Contains new levels to play solo or with up to 4 players simultaneously! Includes the original Micro Mages and Micro Mages Second Quest.

games.name: Midnight Looters
games.summary: Midnight Looters is a 1-4 player co-op horror game where you and your friends explore mysterious forests to find valuable treasures. Face supernatural dangers, collect items, and upgrade your gear to survive the haunted woods.

games.name: Miniature Mania
games.summary: Miniature Mania lets you pick up a brush, choose your paint, and bring miniatures to life at your own pace. The game currently focuses on a relaxing painting experience without the stress and worry of ruining your very first miniature.

games.name: Modulus: Factory Automation
games.summary: Build, automate, & optimize elegant production lines, in a factory made from modules you create. Whether you’re solving intricate logistics puzzles or designing aesthetically pleasing factories, Modulus is built for creative expression. Your solutions, like your factories, are uniquely your own.

games.name: Motionrec
games.summary:
Motionrec is an action game that progresses through stages by recording and replaying the trajectory of your movements. Using MotionRec, you aim to clear stages quickly by recording and replaying your unique motions.

MotionRec is a gear that allows you to record, replay, and reverse-play your own movements. Customize it to your original specifications and strive for the fastest performance.

games.name: Musynx Return
games.summary: The beloved indie rhythm game “MUSYNX” returns! Back to classic gameplay roots—bringing you a pure rhythm gaming experience!

games.name: My Bloodsucking 9-to-5
games.summary: You're James, a middle-aged office worker who just so happens to be a vampire. Someone stole your lunch. Find the thief, feed your goldfish, explore the building and DO. NOT. KILL. ANYONE. Easy!

games.name: Neofeud 2
games.summary: Neofeud 2 is an immersive Dystopian Cyberpunk point and click adventure game that features hand-painted visuals, emotive voice acting, and a strong sense of political satire.

games.name: Owlen and the Whispering Woods
games.summary: Take flight as a small owl, exploring mystical woods and restoring life through ancient magic.

games.name: Paracreat
games.summary: A parallel universe with monsters you can tame!

games.name: Peckers
games.summary: A short clicker game which you can run in the corner of your screen while pretending to work. Peck into the depths for resources and craft gear adventurers probably shouldn’t trust.

games.name: Pigeon Hunter
games.summary: Pigeon Hunter is classic hidden object game. Find the pigeons and other items in a series of beautiful hand drawn environments. Complete each scene and traverse though a dream like home.

games.name: Purgatory Survivors
games.summary: Purgatory Survivors is a top-down shooter with roguelike elements. Plunge into a dark fantasy world infested with demons and despair all fighting for you to fail. Choose your character, primary and secondary guns, and achieve the best synergy with the upgrades to pass the purgatory trial.

games.name: PyroKite
games.summary: Devour the swarm. In this vivid arcade torch 'em up, you play as a dragon growing its tail to expand its firepower. Dodge bullet-hell patterns, wield elemental magic, and slay massive mythic bosses!

games.name: Recon Bracks
games.summary: As a soul awakened in chaos, lead 17 heroes to revolt against the Dragon Empire. This SRPG blends tactics with Diablo-style loot. Conquer 31 battles, collect "Black Gold" gear, and break level limits. Every choice you make writes the final chapter of this epic redemption!

games.name: Rogolf
games.summary:
ROGOLF is a minigolf roguelite, where each level has its own rules and each run is different.
Play mini-golf, buy equipment and score enough points to reach the top!

games.name: Serena Hanazono’s Lost Item: Sweet Memory
games.summary: A short story visual novel with ASMR, starring the cat VTuber Serena Hanazono.

games.name: Shell of a King
games.summary: Test your strength in Shell of a King! A precision bullet-hell adventure that will push your dodging skills to the limit. Challenge tough bosses, uncover secrets, and explore a world left to ruin in this top-down RPG.

games.name: Ship v Maze
games.summary: Fly. Crash. Repeat. Avoid the obstacles for as long as possible, then try to do better.

games.name: Sleeping With the Phish
games.summary: A comedic office simulation where you’re the intern battling a chaotic inbox. Spot phishing scams, outsmart tricky coworkers, and survive the hilarious madness of corporate email life.

games.name: Slime City: Trials
games.summary: Slime City: Trials is a movement shooter where slime removes friction, and momentum is everything. Splat enemies to paint slippery paths, slide into popping slimes for speed boosts, and race the clock to earn the best medals.

games.name: Spooky Monster
games.summary: The story is about a young woman who has been forcibly taken by a demon to another world, crawling with various monsters: zombies, ghosts, vampires, fairies. Now she must coexist with them until she can return home.

games.name: Sprunki Hell Towers
games.summary: Vibrant platformer: conquer horror towers and save Sprunki from Black

games.name: Star Castles 2
games.summary: Physics-based space combat where every battle escalates into chaos. Destroy ships, star bases, and hyperspace carriers before they overwhelm you.

games.name: Stunt Race
games.summary: Fly through loops, smash cars & pull insane stunts above a stunning city skyline.

games.name: Summon a Sweetheart
games.summary:
‘Summon a Sweetheart’ is a short visual novel-esque game, about a depressed loser named Penelope. She gets so lonely… that she summons an eldritch monster to be her girlfriend. Unfortunately, she didn’t read the fine print. She needs a gift, and she needs one fast! Surely, her depression cave of a room should have something, right? I’m sure this won’t go wrong at all!

In other words: give the monster lady gifts that suck, and have cruel and unusual things happen to you as a result.

games.name: Temtem: Swarm
games.summary:
Dive in solo or team up with other players online to face relentless Swarms! Level up fast, and unleash ridiculous synergies in a vibrant world full of familiar creatures and flashy upgrades. Temtem: Swarm blends the chaotic fun of survivor-likes with Temtem’s signature strategy.

Each hand-crafted stage throws tougher challenges your way. Test your timing and teamwork against mini-bosses, massive Tems like Tyranak and Galios, and their screen-filling attacks! Use matchmaking or bring friends and coordinate Gears, Traits, and Ultimates to wipe the map clean. Or don't coordinate at all and just vibe through the chaos, we won’t judge.

Defeat enemies to level up, unlock wild new abilities, and evolve your Tems mid-run to turn the tide. Even if you go down, Ghost Mode lets you support the squad until they can revive you. Collect and master unique Tems, their Luma and Umbra variants, and pack every run with fresh combos, evolving strategies, and just the right amount of bullet heaven mayhem!

games.name: The Doppel
games.summary: The Doppel is a single player 2D action game.The player controls the protagonist, a failed novelist, and tries to recover his lost precious feelings while running away from the 'doppel' that pursues him in the dream world.

games.name: Third Crisis: Neon Nights
games.summary: A lewd 2D narrative RPG set in a neon-drenched megacity of corruption and desire. Make story-defining choices, engage in interactive challenges, and uncover secrets across its seedy districts. Give in to temptation, or fight to stay pure. Will you thrive in the Neon Nights?

games.name: Tlatoani
games.summary: Discover the wonders of the Aztec Civilization as you build your own magnificent metropolis in this ancient city builder adorned with beautiful hand drawn 2D graphics. From humble beginnings rise to build, trade and conquer to become Tlatoani (Emperor).

games.name: Tomak: Save the Earth Regeneration
games.summary: The gods want to destroy the Earth because "true love" no longer exists. But the Goddess of Love, Evian, still believes in humans. To prove that "true love" exists, she comes to Earth. However, the other gods only let her bring her head, to prove that what another feels for her is love, not lust. Evian's head is in a flowerpot. You have only three years to get Evian to fall in love with you before the gods destroy the world.

games.name: Trivia About You
games.summary:
"Trivia About You" is a romance visual novel about furry characters sharing meaningful moments in Carol’s House.

After moving into the shop, you become roommates with three charming furry characters. Through daily life, from spring to autumn, you slowly build deeper connections with them.

games.name: Vectored
games.summary: Pilot your drone through a dark, corrupted forest in Vectored. Endless AI swarms adapt as your score rises. Easy to learn, brutal to master. Can you survive the swarm?

games.name: Which Sausage, Mate?
games.summary: You lost your coal mine job, now you're a cashier at Poland's landmark convenience store. Scan groceries, verify IDs, grill hot dogs, and try to feed your family on what's left. A dark comedy about surviving late stage capitalism, one receipt at a time.

games.name: Wrath and Retribution
games.summary: WRATH AND RETRIBUTION is a fast-paced space combat roguelike where you battle massive warships, collect powerful loot, and unleash devastating abilities. Pilot your groundbreaking ship alongside your onboard companion as you fight the relentless Remnants!

games.name: Wrath of Skeletar: Last Breath
games.summary: Dark fantasy pixel-art action adventure with fast melee combat, undead hordes, and challenging boss fights. Fight through cursed lands and uncover the story behind a kingdom consumed by death and corruption.

games.name: Xenonauts 2
games.summary: Wage a global war of resistance against an alien invasion. Command turn-based tactical battles, build a network of covert bases, directly control your fighter wings, and achieve strategic victory in a simulation of asymmetric warfare against a technologically superior foe.

games.name: Zombie Epoch: Deck Apocalypse
games.summary: Zombie Epoch: Deck Apocalypse blends dungeon crawling with strategic cardplay. Explore dangerous ruins, collect cards and items, and build deadly synergies to outlast relentless zombie hordes. Unlock new characters, upgrade your base, and fight to restore humanity！

games.name: A Little Perspective
games.summary: A Little Perspective is an abstract, perspective-based puzzle game where perception and reality are one and the same.

games.name: A Rat's Quest: The Way Back Home
games.summary: Follow Mat, the Scavenger, on his long journey to find his way back home. Experience a world full of threats from a rat's unique perspective, while fighting and sneaking on a rodent's most dangerous adventure.

games.name: All Will Fall
games.summary: Build massive ocean cities and lead your people to prosperity in this post-apocalyptic survival colony sim. Featuring a physics-based 3D construction system, complex resource management, exploration, difficult political decisions, supply chains, and a robust sandbox mode.

games.name: An Easter to Remember
games.summary: You're trapped in your school during a lockdown and being hunted by a chainsaw-wielding maniac in an Easter Bunny suit. Get ready to experience an unforgettable Easter…

games.name: Anime Fart Simulator
games.summary: "I farted, but I’m too pretty to blame." A single-player fart-stealth simulation where you complete your beach bucket list without getting caught letting it rip.

games.name: Anomaly 404
games.summary: As a journalist, explore the unstable reality of a secret bunker in Anomaly 404 — a first-person psychological horror where your own eyes deceive you. Find and photograph the anomalies to uncover the horrifying truth behind "Project 404".

games.name: Autocard: Your RPG Adventure
games.summary: Autocard is a card game, it's an Autobattler with Deckbuilder, Roguelike and RPG elements. Build a powerful board, unleash insane combos, and climb from zero to hero in under an hour!

games.name: BFDI Blast!
games.summary:
BFDI Blast! A fun block puzzle game for the brilliant minds... Do you have a brilliant mind? Download and play BFDI Blast for free!

BFDI Blast is a game where you place blocky BFDI characters onto a grid, and try to create a line to clear the BFDI characters. Instead of clearing lines, the game clears whole blocks for you!

It may seem simple... but it's more challenging than you think! Think it's easy? Think again!

games.name: Backpack Jianghu
games.summary: Backpack jianghu is a Wuxia theme, inventory management and battle royale game. Choose a starting sect, enter the world with dozens of other players, pick your path, battle and grow, and compete in the final showdown at Mount Hua's peak.

games.name: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager
games.summary: Big Fishin World: Ocean Voyager is a fishing roguelike that turns an activity such as ocean fishing and turns it into a dangerous game of luck (reel luck), knowledge, and the ability to think like a fish! Will you be able to make it through a full voyage or will you be thrown OVERBOARD by the cold hearted Cap'N Grant?!

games.name: Bird Game 3
games.summary: Bird Game 3 is a multiplayer bird-battle simulator where you and your flock defend your eggs and raid rival nests. Choose from a diverse roster of birds, each with unique abilities and playstyles.

games.name: Blackjack Alchemist
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder built on blackjack. Fuse cards into new ones, bend the rules of the game itself, and build degenerate combos to fight your way out of a cursed casino. Everyone knows how to play — nobody plays like this.

games.name: Bus Manager 26
games.summary: Manage the bus network of any city you choose. Buy buses, place stops, plan routes, and transport passengers while keeping your company financially stable in cities all around the world.

games.name: Candy Bandits
games.summary: Jump in with 4–10 friends for a bright and chaotic multiplayer party game. Grab candies, capture bandits, and battle it out across exciting environments. It’s a game night like no other!

games.name: Cat & Friends: Purrfect Jump
games.summary: Once you start, you can't stop! The addictively charming cat game is here! Jump higher with over 25 cats and customise your very own adorable collection!

games.name: Catjong 4: Secrets of the Purramids
games.summary: Catjong returns with a cute feline companion! Play 200 handcrafted mahjong-3 levels, restore lost desert beauty, and uncover the shimmering Secrets of the Purramids.

games.name: Cavern of Mourning
games.summary: Cavern of Mourning is a survival RPG set in a magical dungeon. A tragic event makes you flee your home and search for said dungeon. You will find plenty of friends and foes as you descend the terrible dungeon.

games.name: Chihuahua Controller
games.summary: Help the Chihuahua reach the flag with the Chihuahua Controller! Controlling the Chihuahua will become increasingly difficult! How many flags can you collect?

games.name: Cliché Quest
games.summary: A retro-inspired RPG made for beginners, newcomers, and anyone who just wants a cozy, classic adventure.

games.name: Dangerous Mountain Together
games.summary: Team up in this chaotic 2-4 player co-op RC car adventure! Navigate dangerous mountain roads while tethered together, pulling each other back from disaster. Climb steep hills, survive wild weather, and reach the top without tumbling into the abyss!

games.name: Deep Space Corridor
games.summary: In a mysterious space station, you, as a tester, will inspect designated areas to determine if everything is normal. If you detect any anomalies, do your utmost to reach the correct door.

games.name: Desert Storm War FPS
games.summary: The desert doesn't forgive. Neither do you.

games.name: Devour the Elixir
games.summary: A dark tactical puzzler where you consume poison to gain power. In a world void of Qi, use [Foresight] to see enemy intent. Outmaneuver foes using [Movement Cards] and lure them into deadly traps. Perfect information, no random dodging. Only pure strategy saves you from death.

games.name: Dog Chaos
games.summary: Play. Explore. Cause Chaos.

games.name: Either Eye
games.summary: You are trapped in a world that appears peaceful, but a dark reality festers just beneath the surface. To survive, you must master the art of fractured vision.

games.name: Escape the Dynasty
games.summary: A Roguelike Deckbuilder meets Turn-Based Auto-Battler! Trapped in a dark Three Kingdoms tower, command your army on a strategic 3x10 grid. Equip cards with unique "Wine" skills, master the Art of War, and make crucial choices in random events. Break the seal and Escape the Dynasty!

games.name: F.R.A.X: Blackout
games.summary: F.R.A.X: Blackout is an open-world zombie survival game with visual novel-style storytelling. Half exploration, half immersion in a deep story set in a falling Tokyo. Brutal combat, limited bullets, and a charming cast wrapped in a gritty anime aesthetic.

games.name: Fashion Fupa
games.summary: A tiny dress-up game for your FUPA, built like a lost freeware CD-ROM and packed with enough weird little secrets to make you click on everything twice.

games.name: Fast Food Van Simulator
games.summary: Heat the grill. Rule the street.

games.name: Find AI Parking Spot
games.summary: Master the chaos in Cyber Chariot 3000, the ultimate Rage Game. With unforgiving driving mechanics, you're late for work in a crowded city. Your only "ally" is an AI Helping Bot whose "assistance" is your biggest obstacle. Can you wrestle with the controls and park before you snap?

games.name: Find Your Friends
games.summary: Master the art of deception to outwit friends & foes in this social deduction party game for 2-8 players that blends stealth, strategy, and deceit. Play online or locally through a variety of mini-games while using cunning and misdirection to locate your friends while staying hidden.

games.name: Fit and Fry: Mise En Place
games.summary: Fit and Fry: Mise en Place is a casual puzzle game set in a restaurant, where every challenge takes place inside a frying pan. The goal is to perfectly organize the ingredients on the board, fulfilling customer orders and progressing through 40 levels that mix strategy and fun.

games.name: Forklift Certified
games.summary: Welcome to Forklift Certified, a unique single-player 3D top-down puzzle experience where you can kick back, unwind, and enjoy clever challenges at your own pace. Take control of a forklift to navigate intricate puzzles, activate mechanisms, and conquer challenges in handcrafted levels

games.name: From The Bunker
games.summary: You are trapped in a crumbling, post-apocalyptic bunker, and your only goal is survival. Navigate dark corridors, smash obstacles with your trusty hammer, and find hidden paths as you search for an exit. Each level increases the difficulty with destructible doors, furniture, and secret rooms that test your wit, timing, and strategy.

games.name: Granser
games.summary: A story driven rpg inspired by JRPGS like Xenogears/saga, featuring a unique turn based battle system. Follow Saragat and his dubious allies as they untangle the web of lies and attempt to dismantle the shadowy conspiracy of "The Core", as a far greater threat will reawaken.

games.name: Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell
games.summary: Demons are not the danger, you are the danger!!! play as Angelica Amadeus, a nun with the power of faith and guns. Slay demons at your heart's content on bizarre stages with strange gravity fields. Get highscores to unlock more stages and weapons and teach those filthy demons their place.

games.name: Guānyú Wǒ Bèi Xuéjiě Jiǎn Huí Jiā Dāng Nǚyǒu Zhè Jiàn Shì
games.summary: Set in Hoshino City, a modern metropolis, you play as a runaway girl rescued by a reliable senpai, leading to an unexpected life together. A light yuri visual novel with branching choices that shape the relationship and lead to multiple endings. ~60–80k words, 2–3 hours playtime.

games.name: Harvest Cafe
games.summary: Explore, grow, repair and cook delicious food! Harvest Cafe combines an open-world adventure with a restaurant business simulation, giving you the opportunity to enjoy farm life.

games.name: Hidden Things Beach Elves
games.summary: Dive into a sunny beach in this cozy hidden object game! Rotate the endless scene, watch funny elves go about their day, and find over 130 hidden objects to the soothing beats of a lo-fi soundtrack. The perfect way to unwind and relax!

games.name: Home Is Where He Is
games.summary:
Some legacies carry more weight than blood ties.
After your grandfather's death, you inherit an isolated and decaying residence, shrouded in silence. What should be a routine inventory turns into a surveillance nightmare when you realize your every move... is being watched.

Someone — or something — is watching you. Someone knows your habits, your clothes, and your secrets.

games.name: Hoodbound
games.summary:
Hoodbound is a charming 2D platformer set in a whimsical yet mysterious fantasy world.
Step into the role of a small hooded adventurer and journey through forests, caves, snowy lands, and ancient dungeons filled with secrets, treasures, and playful dangers.

games.name: Hotel Renovator Simulator
games.summary: Your hotel. Your design. Your rules.

games.name: Hus: The 4-Row Mancala
games.summary: Hus: The 4-Row Mancala brings this traditional Mancala variant to the screen. Play locally with friends, challenge a bot, or compete online against others. With cross-platform support for Windows, Linux, and Android, you can play flexibly across multiple devices.

games.name: Hypnophobia; From Your Shadow
games.summary: This is a story about Iris, a nobody who didn't have a Happy Ending and now suffers the consequences of their own (lack of) actions all alone in the most northern city in the world. A depressing story and a melancholic lesson teached in life's hard way awaits you.

games.name: Idols of Ash
games.summary: Grapple, clamber and fall thousands of meters down into a dark and ancient place in this first-person horror climbing game. You are being hunted.

games.name: It Has My Face
games.summary: Kill your clone before it kills YOU! In this roguelite sandbox horror game, experience true paranoia as you hide, hunt, and try to eliminate your double. Fight to survive as you unravel this terrifying tale of clones and biological horrors!

games.name: Judge Sim
games.summary: Step into the role of a judge and decide the fate of every case. Listen to witnesses, examine evidence, uncover contradictions, and deliver verdicts that will change lives. Every decision matters in this tense courtroom simulation full of twists.

games.name: Kami no Ue no Mahoutsukai
games.summary: A censored port of Kami no Ue no Mahoutsukai, the debut game for Uguisu Kagura.

games.name: Kijutsu Rider
games.summary: Kijutsu Rider is a fast paced third person hack and slash anime styled action game where you play as one of five unstoppable heroes, carve your way through waves of monstrous enemies, take down the black cross conglomerate and save the world.

games.name: Legend's Duty: The Rifted World
games.summary: Fight through a fractured fantasy world in this single-player third-person action RPG. Use sword strikes, ranged attacks, bombs, and magic alongside your companion Layla as you explore dangerous lands, conquer dungeons, and defeat powerful bosses.

games.name: Lost Inside
games.summary: Lost Inside is a story-driven, non-traditional RPG about a little human child who stumbles their way into the Spirit World. They soon find out that the world has been corrupted by a curse, and only they can save the world for good by finding the 3 energy stones.

games.name: Manafinder
games.summary: Take the role of Lambda as you are exiled from Manahill and thrown into the beautiful but unforgiving world of Aevi in this Japanese-style turn-based pixel-art RPG. Become a manafinder and seek the manastones as you battle against ferocious beasts and other threats as you fight for the survival of the exiles.

games.name: Mighty Aphid 2
games.summary:
It's World War Worm! Victoria is under siege at the battle front. After a two year absence, Mighty Aphid returns to take on Lady Bug and her evil horde once again. This time, the villainess has created her own Mighty warriors to take on the pint-sized hero.
Run, shoot, swim, dash, and fly. Rescue the innocent. Fight mighty bosses.

games.name: Millennium Strategy
games.summary: Millennium Strategy is a real-time deck-building game with Roguelike, journeying through ancient wilderness, tribal invasions to noble wars.Finally, you can also directly create MODs and write code within the game to create your own cards.

games.name: Mini Trains
games.summary: Mini Trains transport you in a cozy playroom with the best railways tabletop ever, packed with 40 different layouts. You will be challenged to build tracks in situations that constantly get more puzzling.

games.name: Mini Worlds Dioramas
games.summary: A peaceful sandbox for building tiny worlds. Mini Worlds Dioramas is your digital Zen garden—no goals, no stress, just pure creativity. Mix and match cozy props from different genres to craft your own calming dioramas.

games.name: MorTown
games.summary: MorTown is a survival game where players must explore, gather resources, craft equipment, build defenses, and survive in a hostile town. Featuring a day and night cycle, base-building systems, challenging enemies and boss battles.

games.name: My Ghost Roommate
games.summary: A romantic comedy visual novel where you move in with Juno, a shy ghost bound to your new apartment. Share awkward dinners, heartfelt moments, and maybe spark a supernatural romance in this short, charming story of love and letting go.

games.name: Neon Drift Ultra
games.summary: Neon Drift Ultra is an adrenaline racing arcade game in which the soul of the classic Soviet car industry meets the dazzling aesthetics of webpunk

games.name: Night Club Manager Simulator
games.summary: Build hype, manage the flow, and keep the party in motion.

games.name: Nightmare Crawler
games.summary: Crawl through the darkness in this psychological horror visual novel with multiple endings, where you will traverse a surreal nightmare as you choose your own path and explore strange spaces in an attempt to wake up, if you can...

games.name: Nodemind: Dynamic Core
games.summary: You are an AI on a hostile network. Use other systems, increase your computing power, and remain hidden. Every decision brings progress—or danger. Antivirus software is active. Weigh the risks against the benefits. One mistake is all it takes, and you'll be deleted.

games.name: Not Human Nightmare
games.summary: Silence doesn't mean you're alone.

games.name: Operation Terra
games.summary: Lead mankind to its new Earth in this science fiction First Person Shooter/Role Playing Game. Grab your gear and fight through hordes of hideous robots, droids and machines. Loot credits and power ups. Complete missions to unlock permanent bonuses. With procedurally generated levels and maps.

games.name: Orso
games.summary: Orso the rabbit is looking for carrots and needs your help! Guide Orso through an isometric landscape, using perspective to solve tricky puzzles and collect carrots.

games.name: Planet Chyton
games.summary: Crash-landed on a fungus infested planet, Cubit the robot must find its path through fighting alien creatures and navigating through an increasing hostile world with a platform creation gun in sci fi inspired dark but cute Metroidvania platforming game.

games.name: Poisoned Path
games.summary: Poisoned Path is a deep visual novel set in a mysterious atmosphere, where your choices determine the story's fate. Uncover dark secrets and chart your own course.

games.name: Pulmo
games.summary: PULMO is a casual puzzle game where you control a lone character in a world full of faceless crowds.

games.name: Records of Westarea War
games.summary: This product is a country theft strategy game set in a fictional modern world. At the end of the "Age of Quietness," the faraway world of "Westarea" descends into a great war in which guns, artillery, swords, and magic intersect. In there caos, what kind of story do you desire and see?

games.name: Rogue Night
games.summary: Fight through hordes undead, and collect their heads to unlock permanent upgrades while you gather resources to build your base. Choose your class, and preferred weapons. Explore dungeons to find rings, tools, and blueprints, and rescue NPCs who unlock new structures and provide various resources.

games.name: Roguefall
games.summary: Roguefall is an action rogue-lite following a lost player guided by the enigmatic Overseer to scavenge a world forgotten by humanity. Fight, explore, collect, and fall until you reach the final machine: 0VR5R.

games.name: Roll Mad
games.summary: Roll Into The Madness

games.name: Silent Edge
games.summary: Silent Edge is a top-down 3D samurai action game with simple, beginner-friendly controls. Slash, dodge, and fire ranged techniques as you clear stylish feudal stages and tense boss battles, with sharp combat and a quiet, atmospheric presentation.

games.name: Snow War
games.summary: Snow War is an FPS (First Person Snowball) Game! No blood is shed, but that does not mean the stakes are not real.

games.name: Soul Balance
games.summary: Soul Balance is a 2D fantasy combat game that blends cuteness with distortion. Players will control different characters, enter the body of a bionic human that has awakened self-consciousness, and battle its thoughts—all to "correct" it into a normal individual.

games.name: Speed Creators
games.summary: A high speed multiplayer platformer where each player builds a slice of a sprawling level filled with traps and special blocks to race in.

games.name: Spy Guy Europe
games.summary: Spy Guy sets out to conquer Europe in a brand new detective game!

games.name: Starving Merchant
games.summary: Being a merchant is hard enough, but with constant dragon attacks, demon resurrections, and magical wars, it's just about impossible. Nevertheless, it is your dream. Pick your wares, bargain with customers, and communion with the gods. Just don't invest it all in gold right before a kraken awakens.

games.name: Stiff Neck
games.summary: A story about the self—and about others. A toy factory, several cursed dolls, and a horror novel… This quiet seaside town throws Noele's love life into chaos and dredges up the old wounds she has tried for years to forget.

games.name: Subway Invasion
games.summary: Defend a NYC subway train from relentless alien waves as a lone security guard. Scavenge scarce ammo, upgrade your pistol with attachments and sub-weapons, fortify chokepoints, and survive increasingly deadly assaults in this tactical wave-based shooter.

games.name: Suicide Drive
