games.summary: Help Nari and Sena make sense of a cringeworthy drink called Mindfunk that predicts their death. Your choices in this psychological horror visual novel will determine how they deal with this Mind****.

games.name: Misty Land
games.summary: Develop and expand your town as you fend off eerie creatures from the mist. Choose from a variety of buildings and strategies, make tactical decisions, join defensive battles personally, protect your town and fulfill your ultimate goals.

games.name: My Sweet Fairy
games.summary: Play as Valerie (Name and look changeable!), a businesswoman on vacation in a quaint cottage, when she stumbles upon a fairy in the rain. What follows is a whirlwind experience in the fae-realm, with all its whimsical delights. But not every place is perfect, and sometimes it takes human common sense to sort it all out. She finds what she expected least—a love connection, but is being from two completely different worlds too much for a relationship to survive?

games.name: Neon Village
games.summary: This game is a fusion of a "roguelike deck-builder" and "match-3 puzzle". Collect unique residents to create explosive synergies and develop a village glittering with neon!

games.name: Network Notation
games.summary: You are a lost artificial intelligence adrift on the internet. Infiltrate abstract computer networks filled with defensive complications to expand your world. Improve your capabilities to overcome ever greater challenges. Learn about the state of the world and what you were made for.

games.name: OMG!: Overhead Micro Game
games.summary: Single-screen puzzle action with lasers, switches, pits, and a troublesome creature. Solve each level at your own pace, or speedrun your way to a shiny new best time.

games.name: Oblitacrater
games.summary: Oblitacrater is a twin stick shooter where you fight endless alien monsters in increasingly difficult waves. Last as long as you can, raise your score, and then escape before you are taken out. You must escape the planet with your points! Don't let the bugs get youuuu!!!!!

games.name: Odyssey of Dremid'ir
games.summary: In the desolate realm of Dremid'ir, abandoned by god-like architects, a fragile world teeters on the edge of oblivion. Unearth secrets in ancient ruins, and navigate lost civilizations in this danger-fraught 2d RPG!

games.name: Order of the Ivy
games.summary: A new modern, turn-based pixel RPG by Rust Games! Silly tone, serious quest. Set in a dystopian America, the party must overthrow evil feudal lords called the Quorum while managing Kyle's worst impulses.

games.name: Our Ordinary Home
games.summary: A psychological thriller where you assemble fragmented memories and hidden clues to uncover the truth behind a disturbing incident.

games.name: Ourath: A Place in Peace
games.summary: Enter the dark and dying world of Ourath: A Place in Peace. Build a deck of powerful magical abilities and battle twisted foes in strategic, turn-based combat across dozens of pixel-art landscapes. Uncover buried truths as you navigate these cursed lands, where the sky weeps, and ashes fall as rain.

games.name: Parking Jam
games.summary: Navigate through an overfilled parking lot and move cars out of the way to help them all escape!

games.name: Path of Survival
games.summary: In "Path of Survival" you'll take control of a powerful car and embark on a thrilling journey through a zombie-infested world. Your goal is to reach the finish line while shooting down the walking dead that have invaded everything and are everywhere.

games.name: Pokémon Edición Sombría: Vientos del Pasado
games.summary: It is a fan game conceived as a successor to Pokémon Shadow Edition and a reimagined spiritual sequel to the events following Pokémon HeartGold and Pokémon SoulSilver. The project combines the classic essence of the series with modern mechanics and elements inspired by other RPGs, without compromising the original identity of Pokémon. Furthermore, it places a strong emphasis on expanding the lore and on a deeper, more cohesive narrative within the Pokémon world.

games.name: Project Vesperi
games.summary: Discover a sign of life on Venus and determine the fate of humanity in this story-driven, cinematic, branching narrative game.

games.name: Recipe For Disaster
games.summary: Recipe for Disaster is an all new competitive multiplayer cooking game with a game show format. As an aspiring chef, gather ingredients to build powerful food-themed weapons and fight against your friends!

games.name: Rest Area Simulator
games.summary: Take over the gas station and convenience store at a roadside rest area and expand by purchasing new businesses. Manage a living world shaped by dynamic economy and random events. Upgrade your facilities, satisfy your customers, and play solo or with friends.

games.name: Robo Hop
games.summary: Jump. Collect. Survive.

games.name: Room to Breathe
games.summary: Room to Breathe is a cozy space-planning puzzle game where you arrange furniture to meet client needs, balance comfort and function, and turn empty rooms into spaces that truly feel right.

games.name: S-Mail
games.summary: After the death of your lover May, you suddenly receive a new email: she is back, in the form of AI "M". The lover who "lives" in the mailbox, who is strong and eternal, always online, and always loves you. You just need to send letters to her: your choices will affect her and the story.

games.name: SCP: Permafrost
games.summary: A top-down pixelated souls-like set in the SCP universe. Explore the ruined Foundation, face hostile SCPs, and defeat the eldritch horrors that await.

games.name: Set Yourself on Fire
games.summary: A linear visual novel. ------ A quiet town awaits death. Stagnation is the default state of being. Two aimless young women fall in love.

games.name: Shady O'Grady's Overnight Sensation
games.summary: From the developer of the Shady O'Grady's Rising Star series comes a band sim game with more attitude than a teenager hyped up on energy drinks. This roguelike deckbuilder lets you step into the shoes of a startup rock band - write songs, buy instruments, and play gigs from bars to festivals.

games.name: Shane's Trains
games.summary: Build and manage your own railway empire. Buy trains, create services, expand the network, and grow from a single branch line. Map your own routes, or play across the real UK rail network and beyond.

games.name: Sky Up
games.summary: Up to the clouds, fight for survival! Scavenge resources, build your aerial home layer by layer, and become self-sufficient through farming and husbandry to create your own sky sanctuary. Climb ever upward in search of the legendary "Pure Land" above the clouds.

games.name: Skyforge Trails
games.summary: Forge your path above the clouds.

games.name: Snap & Grab
games.summary: Do crimes using only your camera and your crew! In Snap & Grab, any photo you take could be the key to cool crime success. Travel to exotic sandbox locations, photograph treasures and reveal threats, then combine your photos in unique ways to create a rad heist plan.

games.name: Spinera
games.summary: Spinera is a chaotic yet euphoric civilization management game… decided by a slot machine. Pick a leader, build Wonders, and see if luck favors your empire. Light, surprising, and perfect for short, fun runs.

games.name: Squarsenal
games.summary: Squarsenal is a short strategy game with a unique battle system. Defeat enemies and buy upgrades to expand and improve your arsenal of weapons

games.name: Stack to Ascension
games.summary: The beasts have ravaged your ancestral sect, leaving you as the sole survivor. With your cultivation regressed to Qi Condensation stage, you must start anew. Rebuild strength, recruit disciples, and uncover the dark truth behind the disaster.

games.name: Star Witch
games.summary: The adventurer Neia is commissioned by the guild to investigate a mysterious tower in the forest. However, a series of powerful enemies appear one after another...

games.name: Starkheim Tournament
games.summary: Starkheim Tournament is a simplified 2D fighting game set in fantasy universe with a pixel-art style. With only two primary attack buttons, and controls that do not require any complicated motions, Starkheim Tournament aims to be easy to pick up and only just moderate to master.

games.name: Strings of Fate XI: Magic Dream
games.summary: This is an adventure about five brave heroes who have to embark on a journey where ancient prophecies, sword and magic play a key role in the struggle to save the world. Nine schools of magic, about a hundred spells and dozens of sets of weapons. More than fifteen dungeons with riddles and monsters.

games.name: Supermarket Simulator 2026
games.summary: Design, organize, and perfect the flow of your supermarket.

games.name: SysAdmin Odyssey: Back to the office
games.summary: The SysAdmin simulator is a sandbox in which you can try on the role of a system administrator. Every new game day you will face different tasks and problems in the office where you work.

games.name: The Hollow
games.summary: The Hollow is a first-person shooter with a semi-open world set in the Tunguska anomaly and Ukrainian adventure novel.

games.name: ToyBoxers!
games.summary: Punch, Shoot, Or Explode your friends to be the last toy standing in this fast paced physics PVP party game!

games.name: Trash Coin
games.summary: this is the worst... i mean, the best indie game ever made in the whole world. it was made for mobile phones. go through all the challenging and trollish levels, and even though it's ugly, it's a lot of fun.

games.name: Traysia
games.summary: Enjoy the nostalgia of classic RPGs! “Traysia” is a full-scale role-playing game made up of five scenarios, offering a definitive fantasy romance of love and adventure.

games.name: Tretrais
games.summary: In the near future, our player passes by Mars, the shuttle malfunctions and the player falls to Mars in an escape pod. Immediately after the crash you realize that something extraordinary is happening on Mars and you start the great Tretrais mission.

games.name: Udder Invasion
games.summary: In Udder Invasion you have been tasked with a mission by a scientific military experiment: Annihilate the enemy, craft new weapons and uncover the mystery of the anomaly. Wielding lethal weapons, various upgrades and your deadly companion BUDDY. Survive the invasion and reclaim your freedom.

games.name: Welcome to Cafe Lumière!: A Dragon Girl Concept Cafe
games.summary: Masamune was just an average guy who enjoyed going to concept cafes when his life is changed forever after crossing paths with the dragon girl, Marmalydia. Join them as they open the doors at Cafe Lumière, a dragon-filled concept cafe!

games.name: Whispers of the Hourglass
games.summary: After your mysterious death, you awaken as a ghost, drawn to the relics of a forgotten war between thieves and pirates. Shift between timelines and uncover the truth behind the war and death.

games.name: Wordban
games.summary: Wordban is a text-based Sokoban-style game where you control "Wordo" to push boxes and trigger each level's rules, altering the boxes' layout, quantity, and even attributes. Wordo is waiting to explore with you in over 100 unique levels.

games.name: 1234 Connect Puzzle
games.summary: Blending the simple rule of sequentially tracing numbers with the trendy concept of 'physics puzzles' makes this game an irresistibly addictive experience!

games.name: 1492: Colonization of the New World
games.summary: Chart your nation's rise in 1492 Colonization of the New World, a turn-based strategy game where you explore, settle, trade, and lead your colonies to independence amid rival empires and native alliances during the Age of Discovery.

games.name: AI Stories: Machine Angel
games.summary: Will you help a serving, chocolate loving and card playing daemon? Will you dance with a gardening space game playing worm? Will you Repair all 50 robots and bring back 600 Machine Bacteria in this first person parkour movement shooter and become The Angel of Mars?

games.name: Arena of Sacrifice
games.summary: A 2D side-scrolling action game where you battle through challenging stages filled with enemies. Master precise combat, avoid damage, and push forward through each trial to reach and defeat the Evil Eye.

games.name: Basement Breakout
games.summary: A simple, short, and hopefully challenging platformer where Tenma Maemi must chase down her Kanpainiki, who have crafted an escape pod to flee from Tenma's basement. Navigate the levels and catch them before they get away!

games.name: Connect Lines
games.summary: Simple lines, smart solutions.

games.name: Don`t Peek
games.summary: Don’t Peek is a cooperative psychological horror in a cyberpunk style, blending elements of survival and escape. Experience the atmosphere of fear and uncertainty, make critical choices, and control the fate of your friends — will you save them or leave them to perish in this nightmare?

games.name: Double or Nothing
games.summary: Build your spinning board, push your luck, and break the House in this high-risk strategy rogue-lite. Add and upgrade segments, manage bets and relics, survive brutal boss rounds, and decide when to cash out or go Double or Nothing.

games.name: Elise and the Spellbinding Marionette
games.summary: Elise is a small-town adventurer making a living completing quests posted in the town tavern. During a routine job, she finds a girl collapsed by the side of the road. Not one to leave a person in distress behind, Elise carries the girl back to town.

games.name: Frost Station
games.summary: Explore the frozen planet!

games.name: Hexadel
games.summary: A unique and stylish neon drenched layered tower defence puzzle game. Minimalist chill tunes, and loads of possibilities to build the Citadel (Hexadel) of your dreams. Take it easy while outsmarting the ghost in the machine ⬡⬡⬡

games.name: Internet Entrepreneurship Simulator
games.summary: In the context of the first Internet wave sweeping the world, can the player play the role of an entrepreneur who has failed many times but never gives up, and become the world's number one Internet company in this great era?

games.name: Jigsaw Puzzle: Worlds Beyond
games.summary: Conquer the world!

games.name: Kanjozoku Game: Car Racing & Highway Driving Simulator Remaster
games.summary: Master the neon streets and prove your skill against the fastest legends.

games.name: Legion: Dead Metal
games.summary: A secret government installation on a tropical island in international waters has gone dark LEGION has been sent in to investigate ,the installation was experimenting with a new power source and a mayday was received moments before contact was lost "Save yourself" was all that was heard

games.name: Runway
games.summary: Dress up, kick the models off the runway, strike a pose, and be fabulous!~ Runway is an arcade-style kick-them-out 3d action game

games.name: Say Goodbye to Your Balls!
games.summary:
This is a horror visual novel that was made for the RPG Maker Horror Game Jam #15: Witching Hour.

It features multiple choices that will lead to different endings, as well as some navigation sections where you will be able to explore different areas.

games.name: Sex, Sin & Rock'N'Roll
games.summary: Sex, Sin & Rock'N'Roll is a 3D visual novel with side-scroller exploration where a cursed guitar offers fame for a price. Write songs, play rhythm concerts, face adult temptations, and choose between becoming a rock god or saving your soul.

games.name: Stigma: The Salem Legacy
games.summary: Stigma is a truly small indie game. It is a psychological detective horror focused on atmosphere and mystery. Uncover the haunting narrative of an old house and its forgotten past.

games.name: Story of My Life
games.summary: You are a ship driver or something, I don't care. Your parents, and their parent’s parents, were once prisoners. You carry their debt. You must pay back exactly $10,000 by 20:00 (9 PM) or DIE.

games.name: Ultimate Car Company Tycoon
games.summary: Ultimate Car Company Tycoon is a management simulation where you build, research, and grow your own car company. Design vehicles, manage production, make strategic decisions, and navigate dynamic events to dominate the automotive market.

games.name: Vending Machine Co.
games.summary: Run your kawaii vending machine company! A relaxing sim where you run your own vending machine company across a charming Japanese city. Pick neighborhoods, stock up on snacks, and set the perfect price. Upgrade your machines and keep them stocked, one soda at a time!

games.name: Ace Heli Pilot
games.summary: Ace Heli Pilot drops you into the cockpit of a nimble chopper with one mission: beat the clock. Fly through tight city routes, land on tricky pads, rescue stranded targets, and hit every checkpoint before time runs out across 3 fast-paced levels.

games.name: Break Shoot
games.summary: Break Shoot blends the precision of billiards with roguelike builds. Combine unique ball abilities and a variety of accessories to unleash explosive scores and push past each round’s target!

games.name: Creature Feature
games.summary:
Creature Feature is a bullet heaven set inside a cursed 80s arcade cartridge. Fight through waves of glitched creatures, evolve weapons into devastating final forms, hunt ARPG loot with random affixes, and try not to notice when the game starts corrupting itself around you.

Featuring 7 playable characters, endless weapon combinations and evolutions, a full ARPG loot system with 60 unique items, a persistent skill tree, 4 maps, 6 difficulty modes, online leaderboards, and full controller support.

games.name: DaeusProfundis
games.summary: Made in 7 days for EyeJam, for the theme 'Decay'.

games.name: Donkey Ball
games.summary: A high-velocity, “Nanaca-like” where getting hit is the whole point. Launch the Donkey, Avoid obstacles, collect items and coins, perform game changing combos, and try to go as far as you can!

games.name: Dream Tape LLC
games.summary: You're a dream researcher who received a pile of tapes in a lab. The lab you work at records people's dreams. Your goal is to observe the areas within the recordings. The pay is low, but this is groundbreaking technology in it's earliest state.

games.name: Lucky Swirl Island
games.summary: Therapy homework for Lucky featuring Lucky Swirl!!!! Every island is random so you'll just have to get lucky.

games.name: Memolith: Forsaken by Light
games.summary: A turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval city overrun by horrific creatures, where only your wits and strategies can keep you alive.

games.name: Octo's Balloon Challenge
games.summary: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! Master the art of flying balloons and balancing on a seesaw to collect lots of Souls! Challenge yourself in this new sensation game where 'buoyancy' is the key!

games.name: Paranoia
games.summary: Paranoia is an psychological survival horror game designed for both single-player and multiplayer experiences, with a focus on replayability. It is set in an original universe inspired by the Backrooms. Enter the deepest trenches of an alternate universe with entities where nothing is safe.

games.name: Pirarucu's Money Rush
games.summary: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! "Pirarucu's Money Rush" is a side-scrolling shopping rampage game! At each stage checkpoint, which changes with every play, you can purchase items to gain an advantage in the game.

games.name: Plantiquarian
games.summary: Plantiquarian is a First-Person 3D Exploration and Puzzle Game, in which you can collect a myriad of mysterious and magical plants - each with their own quirks and abilities! Consult your trusty Encyclopedia to first find, and then figure out how to uproot each specimen.

games.name: Plucked Up
games.summary: A fast paced multiplayer physics arena where one player grabs the egg and must dodge, sprint, and outplay three opponents while the rest fight to steal it. Ragdoll chaos, power ups, and unpredictable momentum make every match wild and unpredictable.

games.name: Racer Overdrive
games.summary: This game tells the story of your rise from obscure rookie to racing star. A global championship, hosted by a mysterious tech company, is your chance to establish yourself in the world of racing. Experience extreme drifting and nitro acceleration on iconic tracks around the world. Experience a refreshing driving system, multi-mode racing, and a rich main and side storyline. As the race progresses, participate in various events and become famous. Ultimately, uncover the championship's conspiracy from the mysterious host company and face off against an out-of-control super artificial intelligence!

games.name: Rakka: Wake 01 - Soot
games.summary: A visual novel paired with point-and-click elements, Rakka distinguishes itself with its breadth of hand-drawn assets, detailed backgrounds, charming character art, and unique paper-cut style. Complimented by the art is the incredible original soundtrack; spearheaded by the minds behind The PMT, it oozes indie charm. Both serve in tandem, dragging the player into the character and dialogue driven world of Rakka. Think you can make it to its thrilling conclusion?

games.name: Roses of Love
games.summary:
A new stage begins. The trip to a new city, meeting new friends and enjoying a good read. Yukiko manages to enter the prestigious Aoi Academy for young ladies and here she will meet her future partner.

Yukiko will share her day to day life with her friends and every day will seem unique in her eyes. From working in a cafeteria, to reading romance novels in a quiet place at the academy.

"Welcome to Aoi Ladies' Academy."

games.name: Snail's Knock Out!
games.summary: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! Enemy in sight? Throw bombs! Blast away! "Snail's Knock Out" is a casual shooting game. Blast away the undead appearing in stages with increasing speed and relieve accumulated stress!

games.name: The Window 8: Millennium
games.summary: Hey player, It's the day before the Millennium. Follow me, I will give you a unique psychological horror experience. This isn’t just a game—it’s a doorway. Trust me, and I will lead you to see the god.‍

games.name: Toad's Soul Hopper
games.summary: From the asymmetrical party action game 'Goonya Monster' designed by Terada Tera , a spin-off work has emerged! "Toad's Soul Hopper" is hopping action game where you aim for the top from bottom to top! Will he soar into action with weapons in hand to stop Anemone's mischief and save his friends?

games.name: Tread Heavy
games.summary: Tread Heavy is a Twin-Stick Tank Shooter. Use your main gun, dash, and your expanding series of upgrades to blow up waves of robots. Battle across your arena to collect XP from defeated enemies and return to the centre console to upgrade your tank further!

games.name: Yokai Art 2: Tales of the Nine-Tails
games.summary: After defeating Fujin and Raijin, Hiro and his allies found peace at his grandfather’s house. One day, Sanbi sensed a distant summon. After tracing the energy, they discovered it came from her true form—the nine-tailed fox. Determined to help, Hiro and his friends set off on a new journey.

games.name: 100 Tiki Cats
games.summary: Join the cutest adventure in themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of special places and try to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. ️ Can you find them all? ️

games.name: Agrivore
games.summary: Agrivore is an incremental farming roguelike where you equip magical farming gear, harvest crops, unlock new equipment, and create hyper combos in your skill tree.

games.name: Ah. Ah. Ah.
games.summary: A wholesome voice-input action game that can be cleared in about 15 minutes.

games.name: Aquaville
games.summary: An idle desktop aquarium game where you buy, feed, and breed fish to discover new species with unique rarities and tiers. Decorate cozy tanks and customize your desk with cute items. Earn money just by caring for your fish, even while you work or relax!

games.name: Ashen Throne
games.summary: A post-apocalyptic 4X strategy MMO. Build armies, forge alliances, raid the Wastes, lay siege to the Citadel. Mobile Crawler base, alliance warfare, fog-of-war extraction, persistent sieges, player-run economy. Closed alpha now. Browser-playable on desktop and mobile.

games.name: Astro Burn
games.summary: A retro-inspired, side-scrolling bullet hell shoot-’em-up, where you play as a feline space pilot blasting through waves of strange machines to uncover Earth’s mysterious downfall.

games.name: Bangkok Story: A Stray Dog
games.summary: A top-down 2D story-driven adventure game inspired by real-life events. Traverse and experience the life of a formerly homeless man through an interview of how he regained his sense of self by telling his past to a stray dog. Set in Bangkok, Thailand 2017.

games.name: Bongo Waifu
games.summary: This is a casual interactive game inspired by Bongo Cat. Every keystroke transforms into an "intimate interaction" with your desktop girl. Typing is no longer boring—let her climax to your rhythm! Featuring deep Steam Inventory integration, you can collect over 360 accessories just by playing.

games.name: Captcha The Flag
games.summary: A chaotic PvP first person shooter with fully destructible terrain where you need to solve quick Captchas to reload your guns. Build bridges, dig tunnels, and blow everything up while competing in teams with fellow humans in games of capture the flag for the amusement of your AI overlords.

games.name: Cat's Wars
games.summary: Cat's Wars is a turn-based cooperative third-person tactical game. Choose one of the sides, the Kotnaz or the Koterists, and prove who the real cat is.

games.name: City Cleaning
games.summary: City Cleaning is a meditative and calming adventure that will allow you to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life and immerse yourself in a tranquil atmosphere. In this game, your task is to transform the city streets, clearing them of dirt and debris and restoring their former beauty.

games.name: Coincidences?
games.summary: After a sudden rent hike, you move into a suspiciously cheap house deep in the woods. The price is absurdly low and there’s work nearby—it seems like a stroke of luck. But you soon realize something is seriously wrong with the place...

games.name: Cozy Liora
games.summary: Open your journal, pour your coffee, your little cat is already there. While Lo-Fi sounds drift into your room, your plants grow, your moments gather into a small world of their own. Here, time flows slowly, every line belongs to you. Did you forget that peace could be this simple?

games.name: Deathmark
games.summary: An occult social‑deduction card game for up to 12 players. Play your cards in secret, find and eliminate the opposing team and avoid the Deathmark!

games.name: Deified
games.summary: Forge your strategy around powerful relics in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Choose your slots, manage their constraints, and face formidable bosses.

games.name: Dumpling
games.summary: DUMPLing is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter with a metroidvania twist. Pulled into the strange land of DUMPL, you’ll explore tunnels in platformer perspective, fight dumpling-like enemies in top down perspective, and uncover a bizarre story about food, friendship, and survival.

games.name: Dungeon Walk 4: Solitary Insect Princess
games.summary: The main character is a card user. defeats monsters and strengthens his cards and aim for the depths of the labyrinth. Even if he is defeated by a monster and dies the hero has the ability to repeat the loop the power of the strengthened card is inherited, challenge the labyrinth again and again.

games.name: Dustless
games.summary: Dustless is a side-scrolling action-adventure game set in a wuxia world, featuring a richly layered combat system.

games.name: Epitaph: The Parchment Anthology
games.summary: Text-based horror with meaningful choices: wake up in a coffin, explore the darkness and survive rituals, puzzles and hidden entities.

games.name: Fate of Antara
games.summary: Fate of Antara is a story-driven single-player RPG where four elemental ant nations unite against Norbakh’s darkness. Master unique abilities, explore diverse lands, and uncover the secrets of the Book of Elements.

games.name: Fear of Reptiles: Chapter 1
games.summary: They have been gone for millions of years, and have returned to reclaim our home! Make your way to emergency bunkers to survive, while avoiding these dangerous creatures, who will find you if you don't move quick!

games.name: Gacha&Gacha
games.summary:
Gacha & Gacha brings the thrill of spinning a real-world gashapon (capsule toy) machine straight
into a smartphone, with no character training or gear grinding at all. It features a "Boon"
system that lets players share a copy of their collection with friends, plus a level-up loop that
unlocks more pulls per turn and animation skips as the player progresses. Purchases are optional,
and a monthly spending cap for minors is built in as a safety measure.

games.name: Give Me a Weapon!
games.summary: An auto-battler roguelike where you craft weapons by combining materials. Test your luck in the auto-battler style random shop. Build a stronger army with Artifacts, Heroes, and shop editing. Last blacksmith of this world, it's time to become a legend!

games.name: Global Rescue
games.summary: Build your own base in Global Rescue and take command of firefighting, police, EMS, and SWAT operations — either in your hometown or any city around the world! Manage your fleet, hire staff, and take on a variety of authentic operations. Are you ready for your shift?

games.name: Idle Ways
games.summary: An incremental game about building and optimizing your own global transport network. Draw lines, place stations, and unlock new systems as your cities grow!

games.name: Information Conveyed Information Received
games.summary: You are an AD intern at a TV studio aiming to secure a job offer. During a live talk show, you must give directions using cue cards. Convey information based on the situation to keep things running smoothly, boost audience favorability toward the guest, and earn your offer through your performance.

games.name: Island God Simulator
games.summary: Gather, build, and grow your civilization. Defend against enemy invasions. Every choice matters. Endless replayability with dynamic islands, islanders, and threats.

games.name: Kanji RPG
games.summary: An RPG-lite game where you learn how to read Japanese by battling cute monsters! Track your progress by collecting stamps and unlock new areas as you go.

games.name: Keep On Winning!
games.summary:
Keep On Winning! is a parody of incremental games and games of chance where the rules are simple: press the button and see if you win or lose.

Build the longest winning streak possible, compete for a place on the global leaderboard, and try not to hit the 1-in-1,000,000 chance of losing.

Whether you become one of the best players in the world or a legend for losing, every result counts.

games.name: Kyra The Hunter
games.summary: Take control of Kyra, a skilled hunter with golden hair and a blue cape, on an epic journey to reclaim lands overrun by dark creatures. Armed with her trusty sword, Kyra must traverse devastated regions, facing hordes of monsters and deadly challenges to restore peace to the world.

games.name: Land of Disorder
games.summary: Land of Disorder is a vertical ecology open-world sandbox MMO. You will come to the world of "The Aten Continent" as an adventurer where magic and creation are interwoven to write your own legend.

games.name: Lazy Train Game
games.summary: Lazy Train Game is a relaxing game about building out your railway, collecting resources, crafting tracks, overcoming obstacles, and unlocking new tracks, scenarios, and engines. Set up your railway in such a way that your trains can do most of the work for you.

games.name: Legionbound
games.summary: Turn a handful of heroes into a massive legion! Legionbound is a casual retro RPG autobattler where you recruit heroes, discover class synergies, forge powerful Ascensions, and battle through hordes of enemies across replayable roguelite runs.

games.name: Lich of Might
games.summary: In this genre-defying action game you are the boss at the end of the dungeon. An undead lich. Each hero that invades your lair must be mercilessly destroyed using the necromantic power at your fingertips. You are the final test. Your dungeon, their demise.

games.name: Lustquake Legion
games.summary: An addictive idle clicker. Become a ruthless gang leader, recruit & upgrade members, seize territories, gather resources, and clash with cops & rival gangs. Strengthen your crew, unlock power, and dominate the city!

games.name: Mad Yu: Rural Idle
games.summary: Experience the ultimate rural rampage! Help Yu, the maddest woman in the village, automate her farm in this frantic idle clicker.

games.name: Market Hours
games.summary: Grow a trading firm from your apartment to a global institution. Hire traders and engineers, research new strategies, negotiate with your competitors, optimize your infrastructure, and build the most successful proprietary trading firm on Wall Street!

games.name: Messy Hearts
games.summary: Messy Hearts is a pixel-art visual novel about a complicated coworker friendship. Through journal-style narration, Florence unpacks romance, trauma, and some messy boundaries in a deeply personal story of mental health and heartbreak. No choices; this is a linear narrative.

games.name: Metis: Shadow Days
games.summary: A world born from fluctuations, a pursuit of exploration and change. Players will take on the role of a field fuher at the Metis Biological Institute, meeting more companions on observation trips, making important choices, and searching for the origin and truth of fluctuations.

games.name: Midnight Billiards
games.summary: Midnight Billiards is a turn-based roguelite game inspired by Peglin and billiards. Choose from a variety of characters and collect items to build your unique strategy. Aim carefully and make the perfect shot to defeat your opponents!

games.name: Minos Trials
games.summary: Step into the arena of Minos Trials, a 2D puzzle-platformer where brute strength and sharp thinking go hand in hand. Control Minos, a not-so-patient minotaur who solves problems with punches, pushing blocks, filling pits, activating pressure plates, and crushing nosy adventurers who insist on stealing his treasure.

games.name: Mom Life Simulator
games.summary: Manage the busy daily life of a caring mother in Mom Life Simulator. Take care of your children, cook meals, clean the house, look after your dog, and find time for your own hobbies while balancing family responsibilities and time management.

games.name: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth
games.summary: From the creators of Snufkin: Melody of Moominvalley comes a heartwarming new adventure inspired by the beloved Moomin stories by Tove Jansson. This time, join Moomintroll himself on a charming but cold winter journey.

games.name: MoonNight Shift
games.summary: MoonNight Shift is a first-person psychological horror game where you play as Conner Anderson, a 46 y/o former surgeon who resigned from his post because of his drinking addiction, now runs a super mart, working the night shift as a distraction.

games.name: My Fish Friend
games.summary: A gentle, interactive aquarium experience for young children and fish lovers. Watch, feed, and play with beautiful fish in a peaceful underwater world — no timers, no losing, just endless calm and discovery.

games.name: Mycelium: The Silent Contract
games.summary: Mycelium: The Silent Contract is a co-op/single player extraction horror set in a haunted liminal forest. Your contract is simple: get mycelium and extract. But in this forest, nothing is what it seems. So what did you sign, exactly?

games.name: Next Patient
games.summary: During a pandemic, you are a medical distribution officer at a controlled checkpoint. Review IDs, medical reports, and blood tests; approve or deny requests. Supplies are limited. Procedures are strict. The decision is yours.

games.name: One More Delve
games.summary: One More Delve is a physics based dungeon crawler hack and slash adventure. Fight, loot, and explore alone or in up to 3 player co-op as you delve in the dungeons and wield a diverse arsenal of one-handed and two-handed melee weapons, bows, shields, and powerful spells.

games.name: Open Robot
games.summary: Third-person shooter action adventure about robots. Explore, drive cars, talk to other characters and fight your enemies to survive and complete the quest-driven story mode, or fight your way through the survivor mode!

games.name: Outer Space Bar
games.summary: Welcome to the Outer Space Bar! You are currently standing at the top of Earth’s most dangerous, highest, and... windiest vertical tunnel.

games.name: Parking Garage Rally Circuit: European Tour
games.summary: 8 all-new courses across Europe!

games.name: PlaneWorld
games.summary: PlaneWorld is a 2D pixel art survival and exploration game. Explore a procedurally generated world, face night enemies and defeat 5 legendary bosses.

games.name: Portal Brawlers
games.summary: Portal Brawlers is a Beat-em-Up set in a vibrant fantasy world. Follow Thunk and friends as they wreak havoc across the land, trying to stop whatever malevolent force is summoning trouble through these portals!

games.name: Postal Expedition
games.summary: Postal Expedition is an exciting 3D game where you get behind the wheel of your van and collect all the letters as quickly as possible.

games.name: Seal of Magic
games.summary: A turn-based auto-battler roguelike where you strengthen Spirits by sticking and stacking Seals. Since enemies build their power the same way, their abilities evolve with every encounter. No story—just pure focus on deep build-crafting.

games.name: Sherok's Case: Recollection
games.summary: "Scientific evidence, eyewitness testimony, and objective facts—when these align, the truth emerges. As my grandfather Holmes used to say: Whatever remains, however improbable, must be the truth."

games.name: Solstice Chronicles: MIA
games.summary: Battle for survival against waves of Martian mutants in this tactical twist on twin-stick shooters. Using the skills of your drone companion, make fight-or-flight decisions that drastically alter the threats you face. Will your choices lead you to freedom... or your doom?

games.name: Super Candle World
games.summary: An Old-School Collectathon in a cute colorfull world! Leap into this 3D Platformer that rekindles your collect-a-thon nostalgia, and enjoy the bright and light fun of exploration! Run, jump, and fly through this world to gather all the golden cookies for the wicked Candle King!

games.name: Sylvie's Fruit Day
games.summary: Can you please find different fruits? Choose to kill or spare in this underground tale. Your choices matter in this game. Many different ending screens can be obtained with different amounts and arrangements of fruit.

games.name: Tales of Terrarum
games.summary: 《Tales of Terrarum》is a management adventure sim game. On the new land of Terrarum, you will inherit a territory as a descendant of the Francz family, and become the town mayor to settle the craftsmen and adventurers who come to the town. You'll live in and expand the town together.

games.name: Terrafactor
games.summary: Harvest resources, craft, build, and automate your way through a tech tree as you expand your base and defend it from enemies.

games.name: The Amazing Digital Dating Sim
games.summary:
The Amazing Digital Dating Simulator is a visual novel style fan-game for Glitch's popular hit show "The Amazing Digital Circus".

Taking place in the anime adventure world, spend 5 days helping the cast prepare for the upcoming culture festival. There are 5 romance-able characters: Pomni, Ragatha, Gangle, Zooble, and Jax!

And Caine and Kinger fans, don't you fret! Caine and Kinger routes are currently being written to add to the game at a later date.

games.name: The Crosley Tower Horror
games.summary: The Crosley Tower Horror is a game heavily inspired by the real life building by the same name (Crosley Tower). This game is an urban exploration with strong horror elements. You will be able to explore 6 available floors of the tower, including the mysterious and closed off 16th floor. To reach the top and steal the D.E.M.O.N. sphere, you must solve puzzles, navigate asbestos filled corridors, and find notes left behind by the scientists. Not everything is as it seems in the halls of Crosley.

games.name: Toll Booth Simulator
games.summary: You tried to escape prison but got caught. Instead of prison, they gave you a debt. Manage a toll booth on a desert highway. Check passports, take payments, and decide who passes. Grow fruit, mix cocktails, sell drinks, and dodge the cops. The only way to earn freedom is by paying off your debt.

games.name: Velgrym
games.summary: Velgrym Play as Chalara, trapped between life and death for past sins. Explore memory worlds where sinful souls wander. Uncover truths and choose: grant peace or send them back. Each choice shapes the story and reveals Chalara's own sin. Do sins come from soul or environment? You decide.

games.name: Voxelony
games.summary: Voxelony is a Colony, Strategy game, Where you control anthropomorphic lizard colonists and gather resources with other creatures in the same world with full of surprises.

games.name: Wild City
games.summary: Shape your urban ecosystem in Wild City, a unique roguelike deckbuilder! Rule a harmonious society or indulge in the citizens' primal instincts, as you shape your own concrete jungle!

games.name: Wolf With Inn
games.summary: Wolf With Inn is a cozy fantasy tavern simulator. Become a werewolf, discover new recipes, cook hearty meals, and grow your inn! Welcome noble white knights and adventurers—and send them into the clutches of the forest "monsters."

games.name: A Fox Tale
games.summary: A challenging precision platformer with evolving pixel art environments, tight mechanics and instant retries. Join Eva's journey to uncover if she is the last of her kind.

games.name: Achivement Maze 1
games.summary: Navigate through 33 increasingly complex mazes in this pure test of skill and patience. Move your ball from start to the checkered finish, unlock 100 achievements and prove you can beat them all. Simple, addictive and beautifully crafted.

games.name: Animal Style
games.summary: You're a cat running your own hotdog shop! Use realistic fluid physics to sauce a huge variety of foods. Each food is a puzzle. Manage your shop, unlock upgrades, save the furry residents of Pawston, and make sure not to lose your balance....

games.name: Aphelion
games.summary: Stranded on a frozen planet, astronaut Ariane must brave rugged landscapes and shifting realities to rescue her wounded partner, Thomas. This action-packed sci-fi adventure blends exploration, traversal, and tense stealth gameplay.

games.name: BFDI Pop!
games.summary: BFDI Pop is a game that tests your abilities in aiming and thinking... Drag the spike ball back, choose the perfect amount of power, and release! Will it pop all the balloons, or will it fling off to space or get impaled!?

games.name: Bang Bang Tank
games.summary: Bang Bang Tank is a physics-based roguelike. Lead your tank battalion into explosive battles against the Evil Onioner’s invading army. Choose skilled drivers, craft unexpected winning strategies, upgrade your sciences, and deploy troops tactically to crush your enemies!

games.name: BastionOS
games.summary: BastionOS is a chill active incremental game where you command a military terminal to stack ludicrous weapons and upgrades onto a lone tower facing an endless machine army. Destroy a gigantic evolving horde, get destroyed, unlock new tech, repeat, and get strong enough to survive the next level.

games.name: Bolt Bot Screwy Viruses
games.summary: Take control of a robot named Bolt in 48 levels of 3D platforming fun inspired by classic platform games. It is a collect-a-thon at heart and rewards the player constantly in an evolving hub world!

games.name: Brainrot Tung Tung Sahur
games.summary: Made by memes. Powered by chaos. Your brain left the chat.

games.name: BrikGames
games.summary: BrikGames is a web-based collection of daily puzzle games and educational challenges. Players can test their knowledge in various categories, including word-guessing games, geography (countries and capitals), historical dates, and logic puzzles. The platform features a minimalist interface and a daily reset mechanic, allowing players to compete for streaks and share their results.

games.name: CarCam
games.summary: CarCam throws you into childhood chaos as a remote-controlled car! Race, capture zones, play car-powered billiard, or just roam free - all in a giant living room world. Play solo or with friends. Wishlist now and relive the fun!

games.name: Case 1963
games.summary: Case 1963 is a 2D narrative and educational experience set in 1960s England. Explore the stories of three characters while solving puzzles and facing challenges that test skill and strategy.

games.name: Cat Carried Butterfly
games.summary: The story unfolds in Republican-era Shanghai. Lüpíng, a girl raised in an orphanage, receives a letter from the headmaster guiding her back to her childhood home. In the long-forgotten courtyard, amid a maze of fading traditions and new ideas, she uncovers her past and long-buried eerie secrets.

games.name: Coinsweeper
games.summary: Coinsweeper is a roguelite that combines classic Minesweeper with risk management, deck-building and gambling mechanics. It is a round-based progression game with permanent meta-upgrades.

games.name: Criticality
games.summary: A short incremental game about splitting atoms and going critical.

games.name: Cropdeck
games.summary: Plant, grow, and harvest in this farming roguelite deckbuilder. Craft a powerful deck of plants and combine quirky scarecrows with passive effects for wild synergies. Pay taxes. Strategic, satisfying, and delightfully wholesome.

games.name: Cubic Cosmos
games.summary: Cubic Cosmos is a roguelike deckbuilder which combines fast-paced card battles with unique tower-defense gameplay. Build up your deck, construct your strategy, unlock heroes, and encounter random events. Forge your unique path ahead with every step you take!

games.name: Deck of Harvest
games.summary: Within a seasonal journey of harvest, plan limited fields, plant diverse seeds, reap bountiful crops, and amass wealth. Don't forget to manage your warehouse, select powerful treasures to build your deck, and become the ultimate farmer. Are you ready for this strategic challenge?

games.name: DeskAlchemy: Fairy Mine Tales
games.summary: "DeskAlchemy: Xiao Ke's Journey" is an idle to light storyline role-playing game. A young man from a small town encounters a talking mole named Xiao Ke, and embarks on a journey to dig for minerals and treasure across the country.

games.name: Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred
games.summary: Sanctuary reaches its breaking point. In Diablo IV: Lord of Hatred, Mephisto’s dark crusade threatens the heart of Sanctuary. Rise as new heroes, uncover the fate of old allies, and forge your legend in the next chapter of the critically acclaimed action-RPG.

games.name: Do Not Press Me
games.summary: A strange psychological game where every click matters. Press the button… or don’t — but be ready for the consequences.

games.name: DopePie Survivors 3D
games.summary: *DopePie Survivors 3D* is a 3D shooting game with survivor-like mechanics! Countless different little girls, giant corrupted female bosses, and a variety of weapons! Skills! Building! Piloting helicopters and tanks! Gliding through the city! can you lead them to escape?

games.name: Drill Core
games.summary: Corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining in Drill Core! Drill to the heart of planets while managing workers, researching cutting-edge tech, and fortifying against alien attacks. Will you prioritize efficiency and risk your workers' safety, or focus on defense for survival?

games.name: Ecto
games.summary: Play as bunny-hopping wizards with flower guns in a never-ending wonderland. Hold a frog in your left hand and a stick gun in your right as you jump around at 25 miles per hour, picking flowers and shooting robots with your friends.

games.name: Eggconsole Hydlide PC-8801
games.summary:
Operate the hero Jim and defeat the demon Varalys, the strongest in mythology! A classic action RPG representing the 1980s. An active role-playing game released by T&E SOFT in 1984.

The player takes on the role of Jim, a brave young man, and his objective is to restore peace to Fairyland by searching for the lost gem and defeating the demon Varalys. Action is the key to this game. Players switch between attack and defense modes as they fight monsters by slamming Jim into them.

This game is a pioneer of the Japanese PC fantasy RPGs of the 1980's. It is a monster title that reigned at the top of the popularity rankings in PC game magazines for a long time, with its diverse and beautifully composed fields, including plains, castles, churches, and labyrinths.

games.name: Elementallis
games.summary: Top-down action adventure with elemental magic gameplay. Guilt pushes you on a journey to restore the elements in a pre-apocalyptic world. Use and combine your elemental powers to fight and solve puzzles across the temples.

games.name: Error 2351
games.summary: A 3D first-person horror game of survival and exploration. As a former police officer, you search abandoned halls and buildings, solve environmental puzzles, and evade the horror of scientists haunting Ridgecourt Forest. By uncovering hidden clues, you’ll piece together the truth behind the mystery.

games.name: FIFA Heroes
games.summary: FIFA Heroes game will bring together FIFA's official mascots and recognizable fictional characters alongside football's biggest icons. This is arcade football reimagined with matches that are quick, explosive and full of surprises. Players will be able to master superpowers such as teleport dribble, flaming power shot, or magnetic tackle to turn matches upside down. Build your squad, master their skills, and dominate the competition in a brand-new way to play the world's favourite sport. Solace partnered with leading NYC game studio Enver to publish and develop FIFA Heroes. Founded in 2021 and based in New York City, Enver is a media-first gaming company creating culture-shaping worlds.

games.name: Factory Magnate
games.summary: A casual factory builder for everyone. Construct production lines, complete objectives, and unlock new machines as you grow your industrial empire—no stress, no combat, just satisfying progress.

games.name: Far Far West
games.summary: Yee-haw, Cowboys! Team up in this chaotic 4-player co-op shooter. Journey to the Far Far West to blast monsters, sling spells, complete missions, and collect bounties. Work as a team to get in, get paid and get out (mostly) alive.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic
games.summary:
Enter the abandoned workshop of Murray’s Costume Manor and unravel the mystery left behind by the reclusive inventor, Edwin Murray. In Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, you’ll step into a world where every dark corner holds a secret and every flicker of light hints at an ever-present threat. The Mimic, a prototype endoskeleton, can adapt to any costume and become any character, including what you fear most. Armed with only your wits, a few gadgets, and a heavily redacted corporate briefing, you’ll attempt to retrieve Fazbear’s prized prototype technology while grappling with cryptic clues and a relentless shadow determined to dispatch all unwanted company.

Prepare for heart-pounding thrills as you explore the labyrinth of the deserted Costume Manor, discovering remnants of Edwin’s unfinished work and eluding the monster he’s created. Experience Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic, and survive the mystery and madness. Five Night’s at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic will be available on June 13th, 2025.

Disclaimer: Fazbear Entertainment is not responsible for whatever you awaken in the dark.

games.name: Forbidden: A First's Obsession
games.summary: Meet Nemesis; Ascendent being and terminally bored. Until the shimmer at the end of Creation, known as the Void, becomes her fixation - and her undoing. A short linear visual novel with gorgeous hand-painted illustrations; a mythic tale of curiosity and consequences.

games.name: Gene Jackpot
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilder where you gamble with your own genes. Every card played mutates your body. Every defeat triggers unpredictable mutations. Become a different monster every run. Losing has never been this fun.

games.name: Goliath
games.summary: A twin-stick boss-rush bullet-hell with an emphasis on arcade-style scoring. Blast away Titans and dodge exciting attack patterns, all the while improving and upgrading your character. Compete with friends online for the high score, or grab a buddy and fight together in couch co-op.

games.name: Hacked: The Streamer
games.summary: You are blackmailed in Hacked: The Streamer. Investigate clues, make impactful decisions, and shape your story to uncover the culprit is in this thrilling interactive movie. The fate of PinkyPie, a fan-favorite streamer, is in your hands.

games.name: Hidden Cats in Barcelona
games.summary: Explore Barcelona, with plenty of cats and characters. Enjoy a relaxing, cozy journey—now with bonus stages featuring a new progressive colorization effect that gradually reveals the map’s colors as you play.

games.name: Hidden Foxes
games.summary: A cozy hidden-objects game where you explore charming dioramas, searching for mischievous little foxes, all while being carried by relaxing music.

games.name: High School of the Dead Day 0
games.summary: High School of the Dead Day 0 is a free-to-play HTML5 browser gamedeveloped and published by CTW, Inc. for the G123 platform, based onthe Japanese manga and anime "Highschool of the Dead." Players take onthe role of Takashi Komuro and lead a party of the original cast throughstrategic tower defense battles against the undead while building andexpanding a survival base. The title combines tower defense mechanicswith RPG progression and gacha-based character collection, and runsdirectly in any modern web browser on PC or mobile devices withoutinstallation.

games.name: Keine's Expanding Class!
games.summary: Solve and guess words one letter at a time in a brain-teasing, customizable Hangman-style challenge with Keine Kamishirasawa! Test your knowledge of English words or Touhou characters, locations and music to expand your mind! Wait... something else is expanding too!?

games.name: Kingdom Loop
games.summary: Kingdom Loop is a strategic roguelike autobattler focused on building your army and kingdom. Explore many tile combinations, items, and units in search of the perfect setup to beat the Ancient Kings!

games.name: L'Empire Banger V1
games.summary: Empire Banger is an indie idle/clicker game steeped in internet culture and meme media. Players build a digital media empire from scratch by leveraging viral trends, unlocking pop-culture projects, and optimizing point multipliers to ascend the global leaderboards.

games.name: Legion Breaker
games.summary: A short active incremental game about defending from undead hordes. Wield an arsenal of spells, raise a holy army, and fight across ever-expanding battlefields. Start from nothing and progress through a massive skill tree to become the ultimate battlemage.

games.name: Lost in Night
games.summary: Build a beautiful town in the amazing Match 3 game, Lost in Night! Earn gold to purchase a pumpkin house, circus, and many other fabulous upgrades. Complete hundreds of different levels by destroying the marble plaques in 3 different gameplay modes, swap, chain, and group.

games.name: Lottery vs. Aliens
games.summary: Lottery vs Aliens is a highscore deckbuilder about winning lottery money to pay for defense satellites against aggressive aliens. You can manipulate the machine and every ball to skyrocket the output. This game contains neither real-world money nor any microtransactions.

games.name: Lunchbreak Tactics
games.summary: Lunchbreak Tactics is a strategic auto-battler card game set in a chaotic supermarket backstore. Draft cards, min-max your squad, build ridiculous synergies, then battle players asynchronously. Play your way to climb the ranks with quick runs, no timer, limitless combos, and endless replay.

games.name: Magical Princess
games.summary: Raise your daughter while she attends a magical academy. Choose which classes she attends, jobs she does, training she undergoes, and more in a character raising sim packed full of story and over 50 endings to reach. How she grows up to be the world's cutest princess depends on you!

games.name: Mega Load On
games.summary: Ai assitant "Larisa" to Brief you in details 5 different levels with secrets 5 different weapons 4 floppy disks to find for character upgrades Different metal materials to loot 5 different Boss-Fights and Unique story with authors visuals and secret ending.

games.name: Milkshake
games.summary: MILKSHAKE is the greatest piece of interactive software to ever be created by womankind. It is a looking around simulator inspired by the SOUP-like movement, containing ~31 rooms.

games.name: Mind Biotics
games.summary: A co-op horror game for up to 4 players where you explore abandoned facilities. Your mind can be plugged into random electric devices. Can you survive as a fridge? A vacuum cleaner? Scavenge valuable hardware and escape the terror.

games.name: Mörker
games.summary: An old-school dark fantasy action FPS. Fight cultists, undead, and other horrors in brutal combat where everything wants you dead.

games.name: Neocron
games.summary:
Neocron is a 2002 post-apocalyptic cyberpunk massively multiplayer online role playing game (MMORPG) developed by Reakktor Media GmbH (based in Hannover, Germany) and published by cdv Software Entertainment. It is considered the first cyberpunk-genre MMORPG, and is designed to integrate elements of first-person shooter games.

Neocron was released in 2002 and the sequel, Neocron 2: Beyond Dome of York, was released in 2004. Both games were developed by Reakktor Media GmbH, but unfortunately the company went into insolvency in 2012 but survived and is now known as Reakktor Studios.

A small Developer team of passionate fans have come together to revive, maintain and further develop the game, and have set up a Server for the public to experience the game that we hold so close to our heart.

games.name: Next Quintillionaire
games.summary: Become the Next Quintillionaire in this incremental game where you sell boxes, set prices, choose opportunities, and hire employees to grow and upgrade your business. Reinvest your profits to progress faster and get richer with every cycle!

games.name: Night Pump
games.summary:
Night Pump is a short first-person horror game set during a night shift at Route 9 Gas, an isolated gas station surrounded by nothing but forest and darkness.

A night shift at an isolated gas station. Strange customers. Strange noises. Serve customers, manage the register, and try to ignore the feeling that something is very wrong tonight. Some customers will buy things. Some will just talk. And some should never have walked through that door.

When the lights go out, there is nowhere to run.

games.name: Oaken Tower
games.summary: Oaken Tower is a synergy-heavy PvP autobattler where your tower of items fights other players. Build deadly combos and scale exponentially. Every decision matters.

games.name: Ovation
games.summary: Once a celebrated opera singer, Rachel returns to the stage where she lost her son. As she works through the night, routine tasks unravel into hallucinations and memories as a restless presence awakens.

games.name: RAM Downloader
games.summary: Do you need more RAM? Of course you do. Everybody does. Get RAM Downloader and improve your quality of life. It's easy. You click Download. RAM increases. You live a happier life.

games.name: Remore: Infested Kingdom
games.summary: A challenging turn-based tactical RPG that transports you into a medieval apocalyptic infestation. Your survivors are fragile, and every step you take could be your last.

games.name: Repterra
games.summary: Repterra is a base-building survival game set in a world overrun by dinosaurs. Fend off massive hordes while building your colony. Manage resources and grow your army to survive in this dino-infested land.

games.name: RollerBlade
games.summary:
Take control of the RollerBlade, a round tank armed with a gun-sword.
Aim with the crank and fire your gun to propel yourself downhill and gain momentum, and, well… shoot enemies! Rotate that crank faster and you'll draw out your sword to slash everything coming your way!

games.name: S&box
games.summary: S&box is a next-generation sandbox platform that lets players instantly play community-made games while creators build limitless experiences using a powerful modern engine. From rapid prototyping to full multiplayer games, everything lives in one connected ecosystem.

games.name: Saros
games.summary: Saros is an action game developed by Housemarque and published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. Players control Arjun Devraj, a Soltari Enforcer investigating a lost off-world colony on Carcosa. The game features fast-paced third-person combat, boss encounters, and progression across repeated attempts.

games.name: Scaffold
games.summary:
Scaffold is a fast-paced one-button game.

Your goal is to build a path for the main character. Press a button to change the construction angle and hold a button to build. The main character will go faster when you build. Make the main character collect coins on the way to score points and avoid the moving spikes and obstacles.

The game is over when the main character falls or hits a spike or an obstacle.

games.name: Sky In Flames
games.summary: Command drones, deploy mobile air defense systems, and conduct tactical air operations. Choose a side - Ukrainian or Russian forces - and protect critical infrastructure in a realistic military simulation on a detailed map.

games.name: SkyInFlames
games.summary: Command drones, deploy mobile air defense systems and conduct tactical aerial operations. Choose your side - Ukrainian or Russian forces - and protect critical infrastructure in a realistic military simulation on a detailed map.

games.name: Slime Clime
games.summary: A simple, short adventure platformer about a young slime saving the magic.

games.name: Spy Drops
games.summary: Inspired by stealth action from the 90’s, undertake a series of covert ops to save the world from a global terrorist threat. Experience PS generation, 3D stealth action updated with modern effects, randomly generated levels, modern equipment, and head-to-head local multiplayer.

games.name: Stalker From Willowfield St.
games.summary: A stalker is terrorizing the neighborhood, and you’re next. Watch for signs he’s been inside your house and make the right choices to avoid becoming his next victim. Test your observation skills in this Exit 8-style game where the threat isn’t supernatural, but a real man and you have three choices.

games.name: The Last Gas Station
games.summary: In a world where electric cars reign supreme, you are now the owner of an old gas station out in the wilderness. Establish trade, develop your business and uncover the secret of this strange place in the compact gas station simulator.

games.name: The Queen's Quest
games.summary: In this top-down adventure, you are a bee on a quest to find the legendary Flower of Life. Along the way, you'll befriend allies with powers who help you solve puzzles, battle fierce enemies and overcome epic challenges. Explore four unique worlds and unravel the hidden mysteries of this realm.

games.name: The Three Kingdoms: Rebirth
games.summary: You, an ordinary youth, accidentally travel to a parallel Three Kingdoms era. By fate, you encounter famous historical generals and beauties. Faced with emotional and historical choices, will you retire in the mountains with a beauty, or lead generals into battle?

games.name: Watt's the Limit?
games.summary: Click, upgrade, explode, and repeat. This is your job in an absurd incremental simulation where you stress test lightbulbs. Pull levers and push buttons to find their breaking point, then use profits to buy powerful upgrades, unlock new machinery, and automate the glorious chaos.

games.name: Wavekin
games.summary: Wavekin is a narrative adventure and underwater exploration game where you dive into the depths to discover an ancient civilization. Observe, listen, and use your song to unravel the ocean’s mysteries and breathe new life into a world on the brink of silence.

games.name: Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta
games.summary:
Experience a timeless chapter in the storied RPG franchise making its debut on Nintendo Switch, filled with duplicitous schemes, treacherous geography, and secretive characters.

As Adol Christin, search for clues to your past in an epic adventure, making use of strategic combat, and exploring a dangerous world to a newly rearranged OST.

games.name: Ys Memoire: Revelations in Celceta
games.summary: This is the remake of Ys: Memoires of Celceta

games.name: 101 Cats in Florence
games.summary: Join this adventure and discover the hiding places of 101 kittens in the hand-crafted Florence landscape. Earn lots of achievements. How many can you find? Be quick!

games.name: Alice Landing
games.summary: Alice Landing is a vertical scrolling, real-time reaction dodging game. Control Alice as she lands in city ravaged by totalitarianism and war, dodging obstacles, collecting scattered codons, following Alice searches for her brother, unlocks encyclopedia entries, and unravels the final secret.

games.name: Ana's Auto Fellatio
games.summary: Ana’s Auto Fellatio is a hand-drawn 2D adult mechanic simulator and visual novel starring the futanari protagonist Ana. Manage a car repair shop, take on repair jobs, level up with perks, unlock random benefits, enjoy erotic CGs, and balance business, time, and self-pleasure in a sandbox experience.

games.name: Apes Warfare
games.summary: Lead your ape army to victory in APES WARFARE, a modern turn-based strategy game. Command diverse units, outsmart your enemies, and conquer dynamic battlefields. Test your tactics in the solo campaign or challenge players worldwide in thrilling online multiplayer battles.

games.name: Apokerlypse
games.summary: Apokerlypse is a strategic deckbuilding Roguelike where classic poker game gets a demonic twist. Step into a post-apocalyptic tavern as a skilled cardsharp. Wield demonic chips to bend the rules of play, outwit players across the globe, and climb the ranks to become the ultimate master of the deck!

games.name: Ashihara no Anima
games.summary: This is a narrative-driven adventure game in which you dive into another’s nightmare and intervene in the source of the anomaly. As Homura, a hunter, you explore the dreams of a girl who has lost her memory, and experience a story where nightmares and reality begin to overlap.

games.name: Back*space
games.summary: You have found yourself in a space that reminds you of nothing, and everything. A space of rooms, that are both comfortingly familiar, yet strangely unknown. A space of quiet and loneliness. You have found the BACK*SPACE. You aren't sure if you are alone. You aren't sure if you want to leave.

games.name: Baseball Scouter
games.summary: You awaken as the manager of the league's worst team, burdened by the disastrous legacy of your predecessor. Your only edge is a secret ability: to see the hidden baseball potential in anyone. Scout overlooked talent, rebuild the roster, and uncover the truth behind the team's ruin.

games.name: Beast Saga
games.summary: Beast Saga is an open-world RPG set in a martial arts universe where you play as a young wolf tribe member named Lang Jiusi. Immerse yourself in a world of free exploration, gathering, crafting, life skills, martial arts cultivation, forming alliances and experiencing unique Jianghu adventures.

games.name: Blackfire Crusade
games.summary: Experience a hardcore dark-fantasy RPG where tactical mastery is your only hope. Recruit legendary heroes, brave perilous dungeons, and challenge the very gods who forsook this world.

games.name: Blood Radiant
games.summary: Blood Radiant is a lovecraftian soulslike action-RPG. Explore a mythical island at the intersection of many space-times while you find weapons, battle eldritch abominations, uncover secrets, and talk to NPCs in a dark quest to achieve ultimate power.

games.name: Bobo Bay
games.summary: Bobo Bay is a pet simulation game where you collect, mash(breed), accessorize, and train little creatures to compete in races and other competitions. You are able to feed your Bobo an old shoe which is kinda funny.

games.name: Box Dungeons
games.summary: Box Dungeons is a captivating puzzle game that draws inspiration from classic tabletop RPGs like Dungeons & Dragons and turn-based dungeon crawlers. Immerse yourself in a world of challenging puzzles and strategic gameplay as you navigate through intricate rooms filled with enemies and treasures.

games.name: Brightest Bulb in the Darkest Room
games.summary:
A short and surreal horror game made in RPG Maker 2003 for the 2026 SCREAMOLOGY game jam. The gameplay takes some inspiration from Yume Nikki, GOHOME, and the original Slender.

Follow Conny as they attempt to escape their new surreal surroundings. Conduct rituals at bookcases with scrapped notes to try and find a way out. Try to outrun the horrors in the dark as you navigate the strange landscape.

games.name: Chess Peace
games.summary: Chess Peace is an iOS puzzle game where you have to place chess pieces on a board so that none of them attack each other.

games.name: Cosmic Wayfinder
games.summary: An incremental space mining game where you harvest resources across star systems. Discover hidden blueprints, research powerful technologies, upgrade your ship, and defend against relentless enemy waves and massive bosses.

games.name: Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon
games.summary:
Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea: Amaranthine Moon is the otome standalone sequel to Crimson Waves on the Emerald Sea, a Victorian vampire visual novel previously released in 2021. This visual novel is set around 5-6 years after the events of the first visual novel, following Lucie as the main character now that she's an adult.

Determined to make her own destiny as she turns 18, the young head of her family Lucie plunges headfirst in the conniving world of business dealings. Before she's able to seal the deal on a revolutionary treatment to vampirism, her business partner suddenly dies. Lucie finds herself embroiled in the middle of the mysterious death of her former partner and an event from a decade prior...

games.name: CyberBlocker: Complete Edition
games.summary: It is a block breaker with a gauge type power-up system. The player's ship can always fire a shot, which, combined with the power-up system, makes it an aggressive block breaker. The difficulty level can be adjusted depending on the ship, so it can be enjoyed by both beginners and experts.

games.name: Demon Lord: Just a Block
games.summary: Reborn as a Demon Lord, seek revenge on the heroes! This fantasy roguelite game features grid-based combat controlled using four directional inputs. The world only moves when you do: you attack when you collide with enemies. Plan your moves step by step or play swiftly with dodges and parries!

games.name: Demons' Timeline
games.summary: Cyber Detective L solves Paradoxes—bizarre incidents by supernatural Demons—via the social media giant Parrotter. The Cyber Detective Squad, L and his Demon partner Nyasuteria, wield elite hacking and psychic powers to take on the final Paradox investigation.

games.name: Don't Push Your Luck
games.summary: A hardcore third-person platformer that blends precision climbing with ruthless RNG, where every attempt tests both your skill and your luck as one bad outcome can send you back to the bottom.

games.name: Donkee's Adventure
games.summary: A simple, fast-paced 2D platformer where you survive chaotic challenges and explore different environments in a short but action-packed adventure.

games.name: Dungeon Gatekeeper
games.summary: Travel to defend each village! As the last defense line, start from scratch—train units, gather tools, build your formation, and stop monsters in the dungeon. Fail, and the village will be destroyed.

games.name: Exit Plan
games.summary: Grab some friends, set some traps, steal some loot, and hold the regrets. Exit Plan has you race friends in randomly generated dungeons to the exit. Each round creates hilarious physics mayhem where your own genius might be your worst enemy.

games.name: G-Mode Archives+: Xenosaga Pied Piper
games.summary:
A port of the classic title originally released in 2006 for feature phones, part of Bandai Namco acclaimed JRPG series, Xenosaga.

A spin-off of the Xenosaga trilogy and part of the Xeno metaseries, the story follows the human life of cyborg Ziggy a key character in the Xenosaga trilogy—a century before the events of "Xenosaga Episode I: Der Wille zur Macht".

games.name: Gridbusters
games.summary: A cozy detective puzzle game where every case is a grid you must investigate, every clue is a piece of logic, and every deduction brings you closer to the truth. Solve handcrafted mysteries across story-driven cases. No guessing — only pure deduction.

games.name: Hachishaku-sama
games.summary: The "Hachishakusama" legend at a massive scale! A student visits his grandparents and encounters "Hyakushaku-sama"—a 100ft tall entity. A 30-minute comedy-horror playable with just a mouse. Can you survive this BIG night?

games.name: Hamam: The Steaming Backrooms
games.summary: Step into Hamam — a haunting twist on the Backrooms formula. Tired of the endless yellow walls? Here, every corner is shrouded in steam, echoes, and terror. But beware: this is only the beginning... More chapters, chilling environments, and terrifying updates await with every release.

games.name: Hollow Inn
games.summary: Hollow Inn is a single-player inn-keeping and detective simulation game. You play as the owner of an inn on the outskirts of a fantasy world filled with adventurers. While welcoming guests, you must also uncover the "Imposters" hiding among them and expel them from the inn.

games.name: Homgard
games.summary: Homgard is a cosy, story-heavy nonogram (picross) adventure set after the end of a fading world. Solve logic puzzles with new nonogram rules, reveal the map beneath, and piece together a vast, whimsical place that refuses to be forgotten.

games.name: Huaxia: Warring States
games.summary: Build your own epic story in the Huaxia: Warring States. Start a clan, conquer the lands, and build an empire. Or roam the Nine Provinces as a lone warrior fighting bandits and monsters. The choice is yours!

games.name: Industria II
games.summary: INDUSTRIA 2 is a narrative FPS adventure about a woman stranded in a parallel dimension. Explore, scavenge and fight your way through a mysterious boreal landscape consumed by an ever-hungry artificial intelligence to find a way home.

games.name: Istikan Chai
games.summary: Step into the bustling Middle Eastern bazaar as a chai vendor! Serve aromatic tea to impatient customers, upgrade your cart, and keep the crowd happy in this fast-paced, cozy time-management game — Istikan Chai.

games.name: JJBoom
games.summary: A party game that makes you laugh out loud, in the local or online games, raise everything up, throw them out, use your wisdom to blow your enemies up!

games.name: Kingdom Traveler
games.summary: A survival exploration game where you can explore islands, challenge various monsters and defeat powerful Bosses. Craft various weapons and items, place items, grow vegetables and fruits, and trade with merchants. Set sail in the harbor, encounter pirates, monsters and random events in the sea.

games.name: Kugayama Shiori's Death Diary
games.summary: A mystery visual novel where horror meets occult comedy. Follow Kugayama Shiori, a ghost who casually dies over and over as she searches for her cause of death and the regrets that bind her to this world. Her investigation will eventually lead to a single incident—and the truth behind her demise.

games.name: Legends of Wasteland
games.summary: Legends of Wastelands is an idle RPG where you shape your hero's growth. Choose among six classes, master 100+ skills, and combine talents and gems for unique synergies. Idle for rewards or dive into boss fights and shifting wastelands, with pets and gear adding endless build variety.

games.name: Magin: The Rat Project Stories
games.summary: Magin is a combination of a narrative-driven adventure RPG with a deck-building card game. The nonlinear plot, comic book esthetics, full voiceover and game mechanics are all tightly attached to the represented world in a unique fantasy setting.

games.name: Mini Tank Mayhem
games.summary: Mini Tank Mayhem is a roguelike deck-building tower defense game where you command a powerful mini-tank to repel waves of alien invaders. Craft your very own deck, deploy strategic defenses, and unleash devastating combos to protect Earth from pesky aliens!

games.name: MotoGP 26
games.summary: Live the real MotoGP experience with all the thrills of the Official 2026 Season, renewed physics built around a new rider-based handling system, a more complete Career mode, dynamic Riders Ratings and much more.

games.name: NTE: Neverness to Everness
games.summary: NTE: Neverness to Everness is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as its first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. Alongside a diverse cast of extraordinary companions, you'll unravel urban mysteries, ride out adventures full of laughs and heartbreak, and write your own stories in the neon-lit streets.

games.name: No Stone Unturned
games.summary: Why did the chicken cross the road? Hunt for clues, interrogate suspects and solve cases! No Stone Unturned is a dark-comedy noir detective game featuring multiple endings and choices that truly matter!

games.name: Off the Beaten Track
games.summary: A couch/online multiplayer party game for 2–4 players. Choose from a roster of unique characters, each with their own weapons and abilities, and compete in intense versus matches on varied space arenas filled with environmental hazards.

games.name: Perennial Dusk: Kinsenka
games.summary:
Industry veteran Yukito Urushibara and prolific illustrator Saine join forces for the first time to craft a stunning tale about a group of young people in an eerie world of endless twilight.
