Follow their story as they struggle against limitless cruelty and confront the inescapable traumas of life and death together.

Perennial Dusk: Kinsenka is the latest visual novel written by Yukito Urushibara, whose work on Irotoridori no Sekai and Sakura Moyu captivated players with stories that inspire hope as readily as they induce despair.

games.name: Possessor(s)
games.summary:
Possessor(s) is a fast-paced action side scroller with combat inspired by platform fighters, a story told through dangerous characters, set in a deep interconnected world ready for exploration.

Play as Luca, the host, and Rehm, her less-than-cooperative counterpart, as they explore a quarantined city ripped apart and flooded by an interdimensional catastrophe. Their only hope of survival is by learning to co-exist.

Possessor(s) takes place across the interconnected sprawl of a destroyed mega-city, from collapsed skyscrapers to an abandoned aquarium, all riddled with secrets. Hauntingly beautiful 3D environments form a stunning backdrop over which hand-drawn and animated characters, and mysterious sci-fi horror action take center stage.

Choose multiple paths in an open-ended world structure as you look to uncover the truth behind the catastrophe. Meet a cast of engaging characters, each with their own heart-breaking story to follow in the aftermath of the devastation.

Gameplay is centered around tight, fast-paced platforming with a range of unique movement abilities that extends to its tense, precise, combat. Balance ground and air attacks, replete with combos and juggles as you encounter a variety of deadly enemies and challenging bosses. Find and unlock a wide array of powerful weapons and upgrades to bolster your arsenal and explore previously inaccessible areas.

games.name: Puzzle Atlas
games.summary: Take on 60 handcrafted puzzles filled with tricky mechanics, clever twists, and challenging logic trials.

games.name: Real Estate Simulator 2
games.summary: Real Estate 2 is a continuation of the business simulator, where you completely manage the real estate business, but wider and with more opportunities. Find the best deals, repair, organize transportation and sell with maximum profit. It's time to build your empire!

games.name: Red Margins
games.summary:
Unseen is an episodic psychological horror game where each episode tells a story about something not everyone will ever see...

The player was an ordinary copy shop worker, everything was going as usual, client after client, photo after photo... over time, the clients became stranger and stranger... at some point, something went wrong.

games.name: Rival Stars Horse Racing: Desktop Edition
games.summary: Play Rival Stars Horse Racing for the ultimate horse racing experience. Care for and train your own stable of horses, breed the perfect champion, manage a homestead ranch and race for victory!

games.name: Rogue Fist
games.summary: Play solo or with friends in this 4 player local couch co-op roguelite auto-shooter where enemies aren’t your biggest problem; your friends are! Smash foes, dodge bullets, and enjoy chaotic trolling as you punch, throw, and ‘accidentally’ sacrifice each other to survive relentless waves of enemies.

games.name: Samukid
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilding game where you build a skill deck based on dice faces and collect loot with lasting effects. Create the strongest samurai by combining skills and loot for powerful synergy. The legend of the blind samurai and the child begins with you. Join the start of a great journey!

games.name: Scoundrel
games.summary: Scoundrel is an RPG themed Solitaire game. Battle your way through each of the 4 card rooms of the dungeon, fight enemies with weapons or barehanded, while managing your own health, and reach the end to achieve the ultimate high score.

games.name: See-Through Jewels
games.summary: Enjoying a simple, addictive puzzle of rules. Have a happy conversation with various smiley girls!

games.name: Sky Reach
games.summary: Sky Reach is a neon cyberpunk infinite climber where every jump counts. Shoot energy waves, collide with the world to create platforms, and carve your own route upward. Play solo or in local co-op and push for ever-higher scores.

games.name: Slime Tales
games.summary: Embark on a pixel-art roguelite adventure as a brave little slime exploring a mysterious dungeon beneath a sorcerer’s castle. Battle deadly foes, uncover ancient secrets, and power up with loot and upgrades—solo or with friends!

games.name: Snotrocket
games.summary: SNOTROCKET is a retro co-op space game where you and your friends are violently ill and racing to find a cure before the ship explodes. Expect flying snot, projectile vomit, and catastrophic bowel failure at every turn.

games.name: Spellfarers
games.summary: Farm, fish, craft, and cast spells with your friends in this idyllic, magical multiplayer farming sim. Befriend the townsfolk of Wenngrove, learn their trades and stories, tend your home with your friends and Familiar, and make magic in Spellfarers.

games.name: Survivor Legion
games.summary: Unlock more classes, recruit more allies, and build your survivor legion!

games.name: Tales of Justice Academy: Winds Arise
games.summary: You can play as a young martial artist entering Justice Academy. Train through various courses, customize your build with different weapons, skills, and inner techniques. Explore the jianghu, bond with companions, and shape your fate across branching stories and three romanceable heroines.

games.name: Test_project
games.summary: test_project is a collection of ideas about mouse, keyboard and window.

games.name: The Board is Yours
games.summary: The Board is Yours is a strategic chess-based incremental game: buy squares, unlock upgrades, and chain synergies through defended pieces. It plays as a demanding idle game where you’ll constantly reposition pieces and optimize your production until the board belongs to you.

games.name: The Spell Brigade
games.summary: The Spell Brigade is an online co-op Survivors-like for 1-4 players. Team up with your wizard friends to slay hordes of dark creatures. Complete team-based objectives, unlock new upgrades and create overpowered spell synergies. Friend nor foe is safe in this friendly fire bullet heaven!

games.name: Tinkering Is Enough
games.summary: Follow a story driven narrative while solving stylistic jigsaw puzzles! Flip, rotate, and rebuild customers treasured items!

games.name: Tollway Tycoon
games.summary:
Tollway Tycoon is a chaotic little management sim about running the least glamorous part of the transport network: a toll plaza on a very cursed stretch of highway.

You’re in charge of everything the drivers never think about – staffing booths, keeping the road drivable, dealing with breakdowns, repairing potholes, cleaning up after “incidents”, and trying desperately to keep the cars (mostly) flowing and the money (definitely) flowing.

On paper it’s simple: hire workers, assign them to booths, upgrade your HQ and squeeze a bit more revenue out of each lane. In reality? Cars catch fire, craters open in the asphalt, UFO abductions, zombies, prostestors trying to shutdown your operation and general insanity which keeps your team one step behind the chaos.

Every day (and night) you will be given a fresh challenge to put a twist on things, but this does not slow down the other chaotic events which happen. Even a driver having a bad day can throw your operations completely out and risk bankruptcy.

Tollway Tycoon is about that sweet spot between efficiency and disaster: the satisfaction of a perfectly flowing operation, then the dark comedy when it all goes completely off the rails.

games.name: Total Chaos
games.summary:
Total Chaos is a relentless survival horror experience from Trigger Happy Interactive (creator of Turbo Overkill) and Apogee Entertainment. Washed ashore on Fort Oasis, a long-abandoned mining colony swallowed by decay, players must scavenge for supplies, craft makeshift weapons, and navigate a world where hallucinations warp reality and unspeakable horrors lurk in the shadows.

With dynamic AI-driven enemies, a Madness system that distorts perception, and a brutal fight for survival, Total Chaos pushes the boundaries of psychological horror. Every bullet counts, every wound matters, and your own mind may be your worst enemy.

Prepare to descend into madness. Total Chaos launches in 2025 on PC via Steam, with an optional VR mode for those brave enough to step inside the nightmare.

games.name: Vahnora
games.summary: Vahnora is a free-to-play 2D MMORPG with real-time combat, faction warfare, and a player-driven economy. Pick from 7 classes, capture relics across faction frontlines, climb the endless Infinity Tower, lay siege to the castle every Saturday, and forge your name into the leaderboards.

games.name: War Room Football
games.summary: Build a dynasty from the front office. Draft, trade, sign, and develop players across unlimited seasons. Scout prospects, manage the cap, hire coaches, then watch the league evolve around you.

games.name: Weather Dragger
games.summary: A chill strategy game about dragging weather across a dynamic, ever-shifting world to keep everything in balance. Shape clouds, sunshine, and storms as your map grows, challenges rise, and new possibilities open up each run.

games.name: WhamPunch
games.summary: First-person superpowered high-speed combat.Exaggerated physics destruction—destroy everything from streetlights to skyscrapers.Explore diverse stages, complete challenges, and defeat enemies.

games.name: What Did the Chicken See
games.summary: A short, dark visual novel about a broken world. You are trapped with a cynical narrator who questions everything—school, society, and even you. In this glitchy reality, do your choices really matter, or are you just part of the system?

games.name: Wish Upon
games.summary: Wish Upon is the debut game from Inchworm Games! It’s ½ part cozy, ½ part art project, ½ part space-frogger-metroidvania-lite that is perhaps way more challenging than we thought it might be...just like math! Head to our website to put YOUR wish into our game.

games.name: Wonderful Jigsaw
games.summary: Welcome to Wonderful Jigsaw, an enjoyable and captivating puzzle experience crafted for enthusiasts of every age. Immerse yourself in a dynamic realm brimming with stunning visuals, showcasing everything from minimalist designs to complex puzzles. This game strikes the ideal balance, catering to those seeking a serene pastime as well as those craving a stimulating challenge. Discover an extensive array of themed puzzles featuring nature, animals, iconic landmarks, art, and beyond. Every puzzle is crafted to deliver a rewarding and engaging experience, complemented by calming piano melodies that allow you to relax as you enjoy the game. Customize every session to fit your mood, skill level, or the time you have available with a variety of difficulty settings. Wonderful Jigsaw transcends the ordinary puzzle game experience; it invites you on a serene adventure filled with vibrant colors, boundless creativity, and delightful discoveries.

games.name: Yamigatari: For3st
games.summary: Alone in a forest that won’t let her go, Nora is being followed by an unseen entity that draws closer with every step. A 2D psychological horror with seven endings shaped by your choices.

games.name: 4 The Elements
games.summary: 4 The Elements is a 2D Action Platformer inspired by the best games of this genre from the 90s. Switch in real time between the four elements of nature to overcome challenges, acquire new abilities and defeat powerful bosses in beautifully crafted thematic stages.

games.name: A Piano Tale
games.summary: A Piano Tale immerses the player in the life of musician Alexandra Aaronovitch and her father Boris. Can you help Alexandra find the fragments of the secret concerto for piano and orchestra written by Boris, and play it? Travel to the cultural capitals of Vienna and St. Petersburg.

games.name: Adorable Adventures
games.summary: Play as Boris, a curious baby boar who must learn how to use his nose to reunite with his family after a forest fire. Explore beautiful landscapes, track scents, and uncover secrets as you slowly reconnect with nature in this cozy animal adventure.

games.name: Adrift
games.summary: explore derelict ship. find out why there is A missing crew. And be careful of things that could be lurking in the shadows.

games.name: Agerasia
games.summary: Eight time periods from across human history collide in a competitive bid to stop the end of the world. Go from fighting monsters to solving a murder, dating sim to escape game. Experience seven vastly different routes in a bid to solve the mystery as to why you've all been brought together.

games.name: Aha! More Photo Spot-the-Difference
games.summary:
「That moment you notice it — pure satisfaction!」
A snapshot-changing Aha! experience that hooks you instantly.

games.name: All 9 Lives
games.summary:
Trade your lives for POWER. Fight against your friends with endless character customization possibilities and rollback netcode.

All 9 Lives is a small indie fighting game, playable on web browsers for free. The Steam version has a few exclusive benefits:
- Faster load times
- Playable without an internet connection
- Bonus stages
- Arcade mode with unique character endings
- Practice mode with advanced features
- Exclusive "Steam Supporter" tag for to use online
- Development support for additional features and content.

games.name: Amnesia: Rebirth
games.summary: Amnesia: Rebirth is a new descent into darkness from the creators of the iconic Amnesia series. Set in the desolate landscape of the Algerian desert, the game will focus on new character Tasi Trianon as she sets out on a harrowing journey through devastation and despair, personal terror and pain, while exploring the limits of human resilience.

games.name: Antidote to Despair
games.summary: An antidote shop simulator in a grimdark setting. Save lives by diagnosing poison types and administering precious cures. Or risk playing executioner in white gloves — save one, slip another a fake cure and watch how your choice echoes through this rotten world.

games.name: Arcade Archives 2: Cyber Commando
games.summary:
"Cyber Commando" is an action game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.
Board your vehicle and fight to stop a security computer malfunction that has broken out in a space colony.
The thrill of locking on and slamming missiles into a split-second opening—combined with diverse strategies unique to each vehicle—accelerates this ultimate one-on-one battle!

games.name: Arcade Archives: Cyber Commando
games.summary:
"Cyber Commando" is an action game released by Namco Limited (current Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc.) in 1994.
Board your vehicle and fight to stop a security computer malfunction that has broken out in a space colony.
The thrill of locking on and slamming missiles into a split-second opening—combined with diverse strategies unique to each vehicle—accelerates this ultimate one-on-one battle!

games.name: Arcadia Cafe
games.summary: Arcadia Cafe - domestic horror in early 2000s. Work the night shift as a student at a roadside cafe. Meet bizarre guests, get cash for your job, but beware — homecoming may be much more horrible than you expect.

games.name: Bandit Trap
games.summary: Defend your home against a bandit invasion using inventive boobytraps as a Trapper, or join a team of three Bandits and try to get away with the loot! Introducing BANDIT TRAP—a fresh 3vs1, chaotically fun, physics-driven online multiplayer game for the whole family.

games.name: Before Times
games.summary: Play as caveman with friend or many friend and explore strange new world! Survive against small lizard, big lizard, chicken lizard and big cat to find the Mungo Bungo! That mean great treasure in Unga Bunga language.

games.name: Block Blast!
games.summary:
"Block Blast! – Brain Puzzle Game is the ultimate block puzzle game that challenges your mind and sharpens your focus.
Enjoy endless fun as you drag and drop blocks, clear lines, and aim for the highest score in this relaxing yet addictive brain training puzzle!

games.name: Bus Bound
games.summary: Step into the driver’s seat in Bus Bound, the latest title from the creators of Bus Simulator 21. Explore the vibrant city of Emberville in officially licensed buses, and help transform it into a pedestrian-friendly paradise—one stop at a time.

games.name: Charm Studies
games.summary: Cassia is an airheaded young witch who's currently failing charms class... at this rate she won't be able to graduate! Study hard by completing nonogram puzzles, and maybe learn something about friendship along the way.

games.name: Chickens Don't Fly
games.summary: In this tough-as-nails physics-platformer, swing to freedom as a rooster whose only hope of escaping a harsh pit of hopelessness lies in a pair of plungers and his own strength. Grapple your way to freedom, but be careful—one wrong move can send you back to the start.

games.name: Citadel Remonstered
games.summary:
An updated version of Citadel by Pawel Matusz and Artur Bardowski of the original development team with help from Adam Nowakowski.

This enhanced version removes some bugs discovered over 20 years and improves some aspects of the gameplay such as performance, player control, and an update of the in-game graphics and level design.

games.name: Console Archives: Rohga - Armor Force
games.summary:
"Rohga: Armor Force" was released by Data East in 1996 for a 32-bit home console.
There are a whopping 64 different machines! In this shooting game, you can combine four types of Body, Arm, and Leg to create your own custom machine and battle with it.
The year is 2001 AD. The battle between wolves with steel fangs is about to begin.

games.name: Core Awaken Rurumu's will
games.summary: To execute her command “Bring Mankind happiness,” Robot Rurumu hopes she can understand the "Happiness of Mankind" by becoming more human-like.

games.name: Corporate Hell
games.summary: Thank you for your application to Max Potency Inc.! After thorough consideration, we are excited to offer you the position of Junior Chemical Engineer. Master your instruments, encourage your coworkers, and make sure to hit those quotas! Max Potency: Driven by Excellence, Powered by You.

games.name: Cosmic Dream
games.summary: Fantasy Adventure Across Space and Time.

games.name: Crimson Oath
games.summary: Long may the sun shine! Prepare to suffer! Souls-like combat adventure in a unique world. Learn to fight... then fight to realize your belief.A warrior gradually grows and uncovers the ultimate truth of world change.

games.name: Crossed Tiles
games.summary: Build your own field and occupy the opponent's occupation points in a self-propelled chess game. Purchase buildings and heroes to build your own genre, and then compete with other players!

games.name: Dating Maze
games.summary: Navigate perilous mazes to rescue women trapped by a forbidden box. As the chosen candidate, your choices shape their fate. Can you win their hearts and conquer the "Dating Maze"?

games.name: Dear Mirror Flower
games.summary: I am here, in this world... A Japanese-style fantasy adventure by Kogado Studio. In this town, strange incidents never cease. Join Satoree Mizuki, a girl who can read others' minds, and uncover the truth behind these supernatural cases.

games.name: Deep Rock Galactic: Survivor - Heavy Duty
games.summary: The mines are about to get a whole lot louder.

games.name: Demon Huntress
games.summary:
Demon Huntress is a top-down roguelike shooter built around fast combat, endless progression, and outrageous power scaling.
Each run sends you through three randomized worlds chosen from five distinct areas, each filled with demons, traps, treasures, and escalating danger. Combat is fluid and aggressive, centered around precise movement, dodge rolls, and ranged combat using a powerful crossbow.

games.name: Descent Into Darkness
games.summary: In "Descent Into Darkness", you must take an elevator down into the depths of a mysterious underground complex, filled with dangers and secrets. Your goal is to find a way out—but with each level, the darkness grows, and the threats become more terrifying...

games.name: Dimension Ranger
games.summary: This is a single-player roguelike card game. You play as Sun Wukong, a legendary figure from Chinese mythology, traveling through multiple parallel universes to save your master. Defeat enemies from parallel universes and gain card powers from these worlds.

games.name: Distant Oceanic Getaway
games.summary: Distant Oceanic Getaway - A Dating Adventure for WLW. You take on the role of Maeve, a heartbroken woman determined to move on from her cheating ex by embarking on this cruise alone. Will Maeve open her heart to new romance and the possibility of finding her soulmate at sea?​​

games.name: Doorcrash!
games.summary: Deliver food fast while causing as much destruction as possible. Laws be dammed!

games.name: Dracamar
games.summary: Join Caliu, Foc, and Espurna on a journey full of adventures in the magical island world of Dracamar. Run, jump, and fight to free the Okis. Collect all the Moki-balls to rebuild the bridges and reconnect the islands. Get ready to fight the evil King Crad and save the world with your friends!

games.name: Dreadmarrow
games.summary: Enter the dark, thrilling world of DR3ADMARROW! Recruit a powerful party and plunge into deadly dungeons, intense arenas, and epic raids. Battle fearsome foes, claim legendary loot, and carve your legend in a realm of danger and glory!

games.name: Dungeon Clawler
games.summary: Dungeon Clawler is a roguelike claw machine deckbuilder. Players can build their unique deck, fight enemies by grabbing weapons and items from a claw machine and find special artifacts that help them on their quest to reclaim something they lost.

games.name: Dwarf Guild Mania
games.summary: Lead your capitalist dwarves across new lands in search of gems and gold. Each game brings a unique experience in this procedural turn-based strategy. You must vanquish your enemies, prospect for gems, construct mines, dispatch spies, and risk it all. For the Guild!

games.name: End's beginning
games.summary: 'End’s beginning' is a Japanese-style fantasy romance visual novel. As Carter Evan, uncover the truth behind his death and Shermanland's fall. With a nearly 300,000-word script, experience four unique relationships: Brother and Brother, Monarch and Knight, God and Follower, and Vampire and Prey.

games.name: Escape game R00m12
games.summary: Explore 3D space and escape

games.name: Fantasy Voyagers
games.summary: Adventure where you command a trio of legendary warriors, each with unique abilities and combat styles. Journey through magical realms, master teamwork and strategy to save a world.

games.name: Fight for Olympus
games.summary: This 1-player deckbuilding game features a light Greek mythological theme and over 250 cards to collect by defeating enemy hordes with superior tactics, such as positioning and well-timed spells. Unlock 40 deck types, each with its own strategy and an abundance of combinations.

games.name: Flawdread
games.summary:
You dreamed of a demon and then woke up in a place completely different from your home.

Now you need to go to your birthplace, which would be your true home. Your true comfort from this sudden hell.

games.name: Football Rising: Zero to Hero
games.summary: A lifestyle football RPG where you rise from the 4th division to world glory. Build a deck from over 100 skill cards, romance 22 unique characters, compete across 8 countries, and pass your legacy to the next generation. Your football life begins now.

games.name: Forbidden Solitaire
games.summary: Forbidden Solitaire is a card-slashing horror game about unearthing the contents of a cryptic 1995 CD-ROM that should have never existed. From the creators of Ancient Enemy and Home Safety Hotline.

games.name: Forbidden Solitarie
games.summary: Forbidden Solitaire is a card-slashing horror game about unearthing the contents of a cryptic 1995 CD-ROM that should have never existed. From the creators of Ancient Enemy and Home Safety Hotline.

games.name: Formula Legends: Formula E - Electric Evolution
games.summary:
Expand your Formula Legends experience with Formula E: Electric Evolution, the official all-electric championship. Get behind the wheel of cutting-edge Formula E cars and compete on iconic city circuits around the world.

From Berlin to Tokyo, London to São Paulo, Miami to Shanghai, every race demands precision, strategy, and total control. Master the unique challenges of electric racing, where energy management, timing, and racecraft define victory.

Key Features
Official Formula E experience: Compete in the world’s premier all-electric racing series

6 real-world circuits: Berlin, Tokyo, London, São Paulo, Miami, Shanghai

3 generations of cars: Gen 1, Gen 2, and Gen 3 EVO

Authentic Attack Mode: Activate boosted performance through strategic off-line zones, just like real races

Double Header race weekends: Take on two consecutive races on the same circuit, each with its own qualifying session

Manual team selection: Choose which teams compete alongside you on the grid

Fully integrated: Career, Quick Race, and Time Trials

games.name: Geo Brain Boost! 50 U.S. States Silhouette Quiz
games.summary: Can You Recognize All 50 States by Their Silhouettes?

games.name: Get Fit: Power Workout
games.summary: Start your interactive fitness journey now.

games.name: GladiMaker
games.summary: Optimal stat allocation, creative equipment combos, and tactics that exploit your enemy's weaknesses—your choices define the battlefield! GladiMaker is a whimsical Auto-battler RPG that packs a punch with deep strategy and the thrill of infinite growth.

games.name: Goblin's Die
games.summary: Goblin’s Die is an Action-Adventure RPG with a hint of 90’s PC games. You, and up to 4 online goblins, are the new worker recruits. Explore, Scavenge, Craft & Eliminate. Loot everything. Be greedy. Contribute only what you dare to part with. Turn your Hive into a force to deal with. Goblins might die in progress.

games.name: Grenouilles 3D
games.summary: Grenouilles 3D is a multiplayer co-hopping game. Hop your way out of polluted ponds and try to find a more suitable place to live. With a unique mouse only control scheme, alone or with your colorful friends hop to the top!

games.name: Hazard Levels
games.summary: The deeper the rift, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders. Hazard Levels is a brand new co-op survival horror from the team behind Sker Ritual.

games.name: Heartlight
games.summary: Heartlight is a puzzle video game originally developed by Janusz Pelc for the Atari 8-bit computers in 1990. In 1994, an MS-DOS port (Heartlight PC) was published by Epic MegaGames along with two other games by Janusz Pelc in the Epic Puzzle Pack. The shareware version has 20 levels and the full version (Heartlight Deluxe) has 70 levels. In 2006, Maciej Miąsik, co-author of the MS-DOS version, released it under the Creative Commons CC BY-SA 2.5 license as freeware. The source code became available too. In 2020, a web browser remake was released with updated graphics.

games.name: Hell Storage
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game about an ex-con working nights at a self-storage facility, where an old mirror reveals the spirits stalking him.

games.name: Hentai Furry Goat
games.summary: Hentai Furry Goat is a relaxing anime puzzle game where you solve memory and logic challenges to unlock charming illustrations of a playful mountain goat girl. Enjoy a cozy atmosphere, progression rewards, and a gallery of collectible art.

games.name: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era
games.summary: Heroes of Might & Magic: Olden Era is the official prequel hailing back to the origins of the genre-defining, critically acclaimed series of turn-based strategy games. Explore the map solo or in multiplayer, triumph in iconic battles and establish peace on a continent where it was never an option.

games.name: Hex Strikers
games.summary: High Striker, the classic funfair strongman game, is now a roguelike deckbuilder. Strategically place hex tiles with strikers, gain tokens and unlock upgrades from the shop to rack up the highest possible score from 1000 strikes.

games.name: Hidden Horror Photo Exhibition
games.summary:
Is that really a photo from that era?
Spot the impossible anachronism lurking in old black-and-white photos.

games.name: Horticular
games.summary: You have been magically summoned by mysterious gnomes to restore a long-lost garden. Attract adorable animals, build a lush environment, and immerse yourself in this relaxing garden-builder. Will you manage to reclaim the wasteland or succumb to a looming corruption?

games.name: I Fell for Her
games.summary: Renting a small shop and opening a barber shop, Vito meets a woman who works alone next to his shop and he feels like he's falling in love with her, but... is she okay?

games.name: Imagina que tienes 2 vacas
games.summary:
Imagine that you have two cows, if you choose the red cow, you will get milk. If you choose the blue one, you only will get milk if at least 50% of the people chose a blue cow.
What do you chose?

games.name: Ink Shadow: Zero
games.summary: Ink Shadow: Zero​ - A martial-arts-themed RPG where you begin as a nameless novice and explore a world where light and shadow intertwine. From chance encounters to pivotal choices that reshape the balance of power, carve your own legend in the martial arts world

games.name: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories
games.summary: Inkonbini: One Store. Many Stories is a cozy slice-of-life game about running a small-town convenience store, inspired by early 1990s Japan. Meet regulars, stock shelves, and watch quiet, everyday moments turn into meaningful stories.

games.name: Inner Voice
games.summary: Step into the world of "Inner Voice", where the silence is louder than screams. In this atmospheric horror experience you will uncover long-buried secrets as the story unfolds. Every creak and every whisper holds a part of this story. Are you ready to face this nightmare?

games.name: Intown Nightmares
games.summary: A horror almanac that tells the story of events in the city of Intown, built around a science station. The town is caught up by nightmares that in the future will affect the lives of every resident, follow how the impact of the nightmares on Intown will change over time.

games.name: Invincible Vs.
games.summary: Invincible VS is a brutal superhero 3v3 tag fighting game set in the Invincible universe, where you can battle to the death as a team of fan-favorite characters in iconic locations.

games.name: Isle of Food
games.summary:
Isle of Food is a VR cooking and exploration game set on a tropical island,
where every ingredient begins in the open world. You hunt, fish, gather and
grow what you need, then prepare dishes using natural hands-on VR cooking.

games.name: Jini's Potion Shop
games.summary: Run the Potion Shop with the magic-less magician JINI and the little moon mouse ROKTA HYU! Inform and sell potions to various magicians in need. Explore dungeons illustrated in a cute graphic style to collect rare potion ingredients. And the exciting truth of the world is a bonus.

games.name: Kick and Hide
games.summary: A nostalgic multiplayer action game inspired by children's outdoors game, kick the can.

games.name: La Vida de Andrea
games.summary: Andrea is confined to a small space. Her cyborg status and depleted battery force her to stay close to a rechargeable bed. Every day feels the same. She wonders if anything will ever change.

games.name: Last Fisherman
games.summary: In abandoned biomes, forgotten cities, and lifeless waters, you cast your line — often without knowing whether it is still worth it. Rare fish, fragile systems, and a world without explanation create an atmosphere that observes rather than entertains.

games.name: Letter From Heart Antique Shop
games.summary: A story about a girl who finds herself in a mysterious antique store where letters with screaming human hearts appear.

games.name: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library!
games.summary: Librarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Library! is a single-player simulation. You need return scattered books to proper places in an Arcane Library. As completed rows of bookshelves, you can learn ability to improve your efficiency. Use your skills and strategies to shelve 3,072 books as quick as you can.

games.name: Little Spaces
games.summary:
Little Spaces is a puzzle-driven inventory management game about the harsh reality of being forced to move and leave behind your house.

The Player must organize their belongings into limited grid-based boxes. The core challenge comes from optimizing space efficiently while dealing with unpredictable interruptions. The game explores themes of control, personal space, and homelessness. Across two scenes, players both pack and reconstruct their stored items, reinforcing the sense of planning versus disruption.

The game was developed in TU Dublin in Collaboration with Focus Ireland.

games.name: Lord Ambermaze
games.summary: This world and all life in it have stopped. Only your steps can force the flow of time to move. In this adventure, time is your best ally and your enemy. You need to restore the flow of time - and for that purpose, you'll have to delve into the depths of the underworld and challenge the evil Lord.

games.name: LotS: Light on the Sea
games.summary: Lots - Light on the Sea is a narrative story driven game where you live and work on a small island with a lighthouse. Take care of the facility, check the weather, scout ships, file reports, order needed goods or unravel the story behind the lighthouse.

games.name: Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha
games.summary: Real-life dating simulation game "Love Too Easily 2: Summer Pocha." You lose everything in a hit-and-run accident while delivering food. To make matters worse, you're scammed by the only friend you ever trusted! You start running a Pocha (food truck) and encounter five beautiful girls....

games.name: Love the Guard, Be the King
games.summary: The Kingdom and its future monarch are in your hands. The choice is yours. Love the Guard or be the king?

games.name: Magic Twins
games.summary: Magic Twins is a cooperative arcade puzzler game in which Abra and Cadabra must use their chromagic powers to defeat hordes of color elementals and stop the Colormageddon.

games.name: Magiclean
games.summary: MagiClean – is a satisfying cozy clicker game where you clean up a Wizarding School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. Click to Clean, Upgrade and Brew potions, Synergize 15+ spells from your toolbelt, collect magical animals, and grow more powerful each second.

games.name: Mask City: Chapter Zero
games.summary: MASK CITY: CHAPTER ZERO is a detective visual novel that lets you be a superhero, investigating a string of murders. Talk to witnesses, meet allies and fight bad guys. It’s a small-town story with big city spice written by bestselling author Aaron Crash

games.name: Milf Solitaire: Lust Collector
games.summary: Milf Solitaire is a fresh hybrid of patience card puzzles and romantic choice-driven storytelling. Clear the table, win hearts, and turn every match into a night filled with passion. Play cards smart, charm your way through with gorgeous beauties, and let strategy spark something more.

games.name: Monster Crown: Sin Eater
games.summary: Explore the beautiful and detailed environments of Crown Nation, breed endless monsters with the most robust and polished true crossbreeding system devised in a video game.

games.name: Monster TD
games.summary: This is a classic tower defense game featuring a level mode and an endless mode. Strategically combine your towers to defeat the enemies.

games.name: Mourning Tide
games.summary: Mourning Tide is a first-person fishing horror game. A guilt-ridden fisherman ventures into unknown waters. Each catch reveals haunting reminders of his past sins. Unravel the mystery and seek redemption, or be consumed by the mourning tide...

games.name: Mouse Saving Simulator
games.summary: Save tiny mice using your mouse! Guide, push, and carry them through fiery mazes and return them safely to their mothers using precision, timing, and clever movement.

games.name: Mr. Zippy is Watching
games.summary: "Mr. Zippy is Watching" is a short mascot horror narrative experience, where you follow the objectives until the end of the story and interact with the house.

games.name: Mullet Madjack
games.summary: Mullet Madjack is a single-player fast-paced FPS that brings you directly inside a classic anime. Power up your character and reach the last floor; Beat your best time or try again. Haste makes waste… of your enemies!

games.name: Navigatore of the Ruined World
games.summary: The story takes place in a post-apocalyptic world where only two humans have survived: the protagonist and the hero. You will assume the role of the protagonist as she fights to survive alongside Harunashi Mika, the game's hero. Genre: Otome Game / Number of Endings: 17 (including bad endings).

games.name: Nightmare Drive
games.summary: The apocalypse didn't end the world, it just emptied the roads. Build your vehicle up from salvaged parts, manage resources and drive across endless highways. When midnight comes, the hordes hunt. Customize. Drive. Thrive!

games.name: Ninjam!
games.summary: "Ninjam! is a multiplayer action game for up to 4 players where cute ninja characters move freely and compete against each other on a 3D map."

games.name: Oceanside Whispers
games.summary: In Oceanside Whispers, the ocean is your canvas. Build and decorate spaces above or beneath the waves. Arrange rooms, add light, furniture, and cozy details to create calm retreats.

games.name: Opaloid Kingdom
games.summary: Explore dungeons filled with monsters, traps and gold coins! Opaloid Kingdom is a retro-style dungeon crawler set in a medieval world. Enjoy quick and satisfying gameplay in a magical land full of wizards, treasure and dragons!

games.name: Our Home, My Keeper
games.summary: A fairytale-inspired yuri visual novel full of magic. Follow Paige, a struggling writer, as she moves into a spacious home in the English countryside, where she meets the mysterious Faye.

games.name: Outlive 25
games.summary: Old school RTS is back! Outlive 25 is the remastered version of the game originally released in 2000, that will be featuring enhanced graphics and sound, an updated Campaign Editor, Steam multiplayer support, and much more. Get ready for a battle of unprecedented proportions, fought to achieve supremacy—and above all—to ensure humanity’s survival.

games.name: Oversynth
games.summary: Welcome to OVERSYNTH, AKOD for short. A game about rending robots apart with a sword, which is still in alpha. But there is already an infinite mode, three different testing polygons, 5 different enemies and, of course, EXPLOSIONS!!! And... Well... Ummmm... COOL EXPLOSIONS!!! YAY!

games.name: Paralysis
games.summary:
You wake up in a cold empty classroom... you can't feel your body..

No memory of what happen...

Find your way out before it... comes..

games.name: Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend
games.summary:
Path of Gear: Blacksmith’s Legend is a tactical roguelite RPG that combines timeline-based turn-based combat with dynamic weapon forging.
Play as a legendary blacksmith who forges powerful weapons and supports adventurers in wielding them effectively.
Explore procedurally generated maps, face unpredictable events, and battle formidable foes in a journey filled with strategic challenges and surprises.

games.name: Penance
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the unsettling atmosphere of Penance, a mystery adventure where every step in your search for the truth brings you closer to the abyss. Explore a gloomy monastery and unearth ancient secrets that will test the fragile duality between your guilt and your faith.

games.name: Picross S Konami Antiques Edition
games.summary: Familiar characters from KONAMI games are making an appearance in the Picross S series for Nintendo Switch! More than 80 titles are included. Characters from a wide range of game genres - from sports to dating sims and beloved game series like Castlevania, Contra, and Gradius - have been turned into pixel art puzzles.

games.name: Pixicharm: Hidden Ninja Dojo
games.summary:
Hidden Ninja Dojo is a charming hidden object-style game that challenges you to find ninjas hidden throughout each level. Carefully explore every scene, pay attention to small details, and uncover every ninja before moving on.

What looks simple at first can quickly become tricky, as ninjas blend into the background and hide in unexpected places. Whether you are a casual player or a fan of hidden object games, Hidden Ninja Dojo offers a relaxing and satisfying search experience.

games.name: Porta-Tower
games.summary: Porta-Tower is a roguelike tower defense game where you can pick up and move your towers when their position becomes suboptimal. Relocate, upgrade, and unlock towers to defend your portal until the very end.

games.name: Prehistoric Pack
games.summary: Prehistoric Pack is a dinosaur auto battler. Each turn, rip open card packs of dinosaurs to create a ferocious dinosaur pack. Then, your dinos will automatically battle an enemy team. Win rounds to collect Bones and open more packs, then fill the Apex Meter to unleash devastating power on your prey!

games.name: Project: Aurora
games.summary: Project: Aurora is an exploration game combining elements of RTS, survival and adventure games. You are the captain of the research mission, which lands on the surface of the newly discovered planet.

games.name: Protocol: Annihilation
games.summary: Assume control of a combat robot in a relentless sci-fi shooter where total destruction is the only directive.

games.name: Quiet Soul
games.summary: A cooperative psychological horror where the house manipulates each player differently. Share clues, question reality, and find out who — if anyone — makes it out together.

games.name: Quiz: Don’t Lose to a Kid!
games.summary:
A kid could answer that in a second.
A four-choice knowledge quiz that puts adult pride to the test.

games.name: RMN Soup
games.summary:
A Soup-like is a game inspired by the Japanese art game SOUP.

RMN Soup is a collaborative soup-like created using the Bapalon engine by users of rpgmaker.net. It is a pure exploration simulator where you go through a series of rooms and enjoy the scenery. Some are funny, some are unnerving, and some are cozy. You never know what you're going to get next!

RMN Soup currently contains 28 rooms by a total of 9 contributors.

games.name: Raspberry's Berry Match
games.summary: A dot-eating game where you control Player 1 with the left stick and Player 2 with the right stick using a single controller! Grab the controller together and enjoy some co-op play! Collect all four scattered marks at the concert venue and deliver them to the stage where Raspberry is waiting!

games.name: Reflex Rush
games.summary: One button. One chance. Press, wait, and react in time. Every success makes it harder. One mistake resets everything. How far can you go?

games.name: Room 713
games.summary:
Room 713 blends classic anomaly-spotting Exit 8-style gameplay with a murder mystery narrative. Pay close attention to your surroundings. Notice something wrong? Head left. Everything in order? Go right. With every correct choice, you climb a floor. Every mistake sends you back to the start.

The game features over 40 anomalies. Can you spot them all?

games.name: SCP Extraction Protocol
games.summary: Industrial horror about isolation, obedience, and the sound coming from below.

games.name: SCP-9779-JP
games.summary: A psychological horror about survival in a cursed Japanese mansion and underground SCP laboratories. Hide, survive, and return SCP-9779-JP to its containment chamber before it destroys you.

games.name: ScooterFlow
games.summary: The world’s most realistic freestyle scooter game is finally here. Ride the skatepark, hit the streets, boost the mega ramp, fully customize your scooter & throw down all of the real life trick combinations you could dream of within this physics based scooter game.

games.name: Sever
games.summary: Down to your last $100, but flesh has value. Trade pieces for cash and gamble with your very life. Will you make it out rich… or become part of the collection?

games.name: Shinigami Hime to Ishokan no Kaibutsu
games.summary: This game tells a story of heart-to-heart connections and salvation surrounding Mono, a girl who visits the medical facility “Ishokan” in hopes of saving her older sister, who has been afflicted by the terrifying “Shinigami Disease”; Melhendia, a goat-like creature who seeks to exploit her; and the girls who the disease have transformed into strange creatures.

games.name: Skyship Quest Story
games.summary: Customize your airship and explore the world above the clouds in this sim RPG

games.name: Sledding Game
games.summary: Sledding Game is a cozy, online multiplayer game about sledding, relaxing, and hanging out with your friends.

games.name: So Quirky! Puzzle Escape Game
games.summary:
Can you spot what's off?
Crack these quirky puzzles by instinct! A drag-and-drop brain-teaser escape game!

games.name: Solo Knight
games.summary: Solo Knight is a hardcore Diablo-like game that has been designed and polished for 5 years. Come and create your Build from more than 200 pieces of equipment and 600 perks. Massive contents await you to explore.

games.name: Speed Rivals: Slot Racing
games.summary: Speed Rivals is an arcade-style slot racing game where players control miniature cars fixed on rails, adjusting their speed to master corners and outpace their rivals. Inspired by classic toy car tracks, the game offers a mix of fast-paced competition and creative freedom. Players can unlock and customize dozens of unique vehicles, race through themed environments, and even build their own tracks. With multiplayer modes, community tournaments, and a growing garage of cars from pop culture and racing history, Speed Rivals brings the thrill of slot racing to a new generation.

games.name: Spooky Cooking
games.summary: Have a nice Halloween in a lovely and casual way with a one-button game that tries to bring back the competition of the arcade era, where you need to shoot a pumpkin towards to a cauldron while dodging obstacles, a simple mechanic that's easy to understand, but hard to master, this game can please casual gamers as well as hardcore ones.

games.name: Spori
games.summary: Spori is a short story-driven psychological horror game, where you play as a janitor in the early 2000s.

games.name: Starseeker: Astroneer Expeditions
games.summary: STARSEEKER is a new game set within the Astroneer universe with a focus on discovery, cooperative expeditions, and camaraderie. Exploring deep space on the ESS Starseeker, players will need to work together with the entire crew of the space station to complete planet- wide objectives across a multitude of star systems using cutting edge technology.

games.name: Starshot Idle
games.summary: Starshot Idle is a Retro Space-Themed Shooter Idle that sits on your desktop and runs while you work or game.

games.name: Stigma: Unnamed
games.summary: Introduce tactical rhythm combat in Stigma, a semi-auto action roguelike. Command 100+ stunning agents and craft game-breaking builds with 40 unique Black Box items. Synchronize your frequency to decimate the Noise in this high-octane, dark futurism experience.

games.name: Strange Antiquities
games.summary: Become the custodian of a store dealing in occult antiquities. Explore the quaint and gloomy town of Undermere, where strange goings-on and dark mysteries abound. Find and identify arcane artefacts, use your collection to aid the townsfolk with their unusual problems — and remember to pet your cat!

games.name: Survivor Mercs
games.summary: Lead your squad of Mercs against M.E.G.A. Corp.'s evil robot army. Fast-paced twin-stick action, frantic horde survival, tactical squad-building & lots of loot! Exploit game-breaking synergies and beat the evil billionaire bosses in ever-changing operations. Lock, load, and loot, Commander!

games.name: Swarm Survivor: Endless Siege
games.summary: Swarm Survivors: Endless Siege is a light roguelike bullet-hell idle shooter. You play as the last survivor of the Swarm, fighting to stay alive under the endless siege of alien fleets. Build overwhelming power and face wave after wave of relentless challenges.

games.name: Tab + Notch
games.summary: Tab + Notch is a puzzlers game. If you like to build puzzles, and want to do it anywhere, maybe compete against others for the top of the leaderboard, or build them together with friends. Tab + Notch is here for you. As the developer of the game, I wanted something chill that I could do from anywhere, and I like building jigsaw puzzles. I wanted something for myself, and others thought it was cool, so here we go.

games.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Empire City
games.summary: A brotherhood in the shadows. A city on the brink. In the vacuum left by Shredder's demise, the Foot Clan's grip tightens on the streets you once called home. In the first-ever TMNT first-person action adventure VR game - forge your own chapter, solo or in co-op with up to three friends. Coming 2026

games.name: Tellus: Echo of the Void
games.summary: Adapt a barren world to sustain human life. Explore, gather materials, and establish your base. Then, manipulate the environment by producing air, warmth, and atmospheric pressure to create a living ecosystem.

games.name: TerraTech Legion
games.summary: Build the ultimate battle vehicle and rage against the machines in a chaotic Bullet Heaven Builder. Master a deep, block-based vehicle-building system to survive an army of robotic foes driven by a crazed AI, ramming them at speed and shooting infinite projectiles.

games.name: The Bucketlist Tourist
games.summary: The Bucketlist Tourist is a physics-based multiplayer party game where players complete tasks and capture them photographically. In the battle for the best snapshot, they share only a single camera.

games.name: The Coma 3: Bloodlines
games.summary: Welcome to the world of The Coma 3: Bloodlines. In this realm of shadows rumors and urban legends become reality, and danger lurks around every corner. If a living intruder dies here, their body will be severed from their spirit and never wake again ...

games.name: The Rhymatory
games.summary: The Rhymatory is a mobile word game with over 300 rhyming riddles to solve in a cozy, steampunk atmosphere. For each riddle, players must answer with a pair of rhyming words. A fox, an owl, and a crow accompany you to provide hints as needed and brew a steady supply of tea.

games.name: The Shocking World Mysteries
games.summary:
That nagging feeling is the doorway to the truth.
Tap your way to the shocking secrets behind each baffling case!

games.name: The Shore: Enhanced Edition
games.summary: The complete experience unfolds in The Shore, a first-person Lovecraftian horror adventure that blends exploration and puzzles in a world shaped by ancient gods and forbidden knowledge.

games.name: The Stairwell
games.summary: You've been hired to keep watch in a mysterious building with an infinite stairwell. Your task is simple: investigate each floor for strange phenomena. If you find an anomaly, be careful. Test your skills on the global leaderboard and in the weekly challenge event.

games.name: Tiny Auto Knights
games.summary: An asynchronous PvP Auto Battler where you have to recruit and upgrade heroes and place them strategically on the battlefield to compete against other players.

games.name: Touhou Unite Arena
games.summary: "Touhou Unite Arena" is a card Roguelike game based on the theme of the Touhou Project. Build your own team, combine the spell cards in your hand, play explosive attack values, defeat the target enemy step by step, and challenge the final champion!

games.name: Touhou: Records of Wealth-Seeking
games.summary: Touhou: Records of Wealth-Seeking is a funny, chaotic visual novel and perfect for Touhou newcomers. No prior knowledge needed to enjoy it. Play as Keine, buy up Gensokyo’s assets, and face the invasion from the Outside World. You’ll meet all kinds of weirdos—and you’re one of them too.

games.name: Toycrafter
games.summary: You lost your passion for crafting small toys. You shifted your focus to working on larger dolls. Cut, paint and attach doll parts to build unique and unsettling sculptures. Ignore any anomalies you see or hear. Don't forget to lock the door & wishlist before you leave

games.name: Trick Room Mysteries
games.summary:
"Something's wrong with this house."
A pixel-art mystery where you crack each case with 4 choices!

games.name: Twin Shot Deluxe
games.summary: The Angel Cats are back! Twin Shot Deluxe is a platform arcade shooter where players defend their homeland using bow and arrows. Take aim at 200+ brand new levels set across four worlds. Play solo or with a friends in local co-op (1-4 players) or competitively to see who will be crowned champion.

games.name: TwoOrThree
games.summary: Let's play with multiples of 2 and 3 with Shuri!

games.name: Ultimate Romance Test
games.summary: 100 questions to reveal your one-and-only love destiny!

games.name: Unbox the Room
games.summary: Unbox the Room is a relaxing puzzle game where you unpack and arrange items and furniture in your new home. Create a cozy space by placing everything just right, from the smallest cup to the largest sofa.

games.name: Unbox your Workspace
games.summary: Unpack creativity and build your perfect workspace! Open boxes with furniture and decor, organize your setup, and create a functional, stylish environment that boosts comfort and productivity.

games.name: Unfair War: Survivors
games.summary: This is NOT a "forever" roguelike for thousands of hours. It's a game for a few cozy evenings. Download — launch — play immediately. No skill trees, no boring meta-grind. Just pure co-op action: you're chained together, dodging waves of robots, throwing grenades, and triggering ultimates.

games.name: Valenium
games.summary: Brutal combat, a deep skill system, and a magical universe. Let your sword, staff, or bow speak in this fantasy world. Hunt the aggressive 'The Evolved', mutated by Valenium. A deep story and ancient secrets await you.

games.name: Walk of Life
games.summary: Walk of Life is a competitive life simulator for up to 6 players! Choose from a cast of unique roles and duke it out with your friends, bots, or by yourself, in this wacky and ever-surprising party game!

games.name: Who Summoned It?
games.summary: Unravel the Knotgud disaster in this point and click deduction mystery. Explore the town of Knotgud, interrogate townsfolk, and use magical items. Use your discoveries to piece events together in your scroll of truth and find out, Who Summoned It?

games.name: Winx Club: The Magic Is Back
games.summary: Winx Club: The Magic is Back captures the essence of the Winx universe, delivering an enchanting experience with a mix of magical combat and puzzle-solving. Play as all six members of the Winx Club, each with their own magical abilities.

games.name: Wreck Runners
games.summary: Wreck Runners is a 1-4 player online co-op extraction game set in a haunted and ever-changing Bermuda Triangle. Hired by the suspiciously cheerful Trustwell Corporation, your crew of runners is sent in to recover valuable salvage. We expect you may find far more than sunken wrecks waiting in the Fog.
